1.title: WRITING — PART 1
intro: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. You received an email from your English friend, Jenny.
She knows that your birthday is coming soon and would like to help you organize a party. Read part of her email below.
quote: Your birthday is only two weeks away! I would love to help you plan a small party to celebrate it with our friends. Before I start, I need to ask you a few questions.
- Where would you like to have the party?
- When is the best time for the party?
- If you could receive any present, what would you wish for?
1.instruction: Write an email responding to Jenny. You should write at least 120 words. You don't need to include your name or addresses. Your response will be evaluated in terms of Task Fulfillment, Organization, Vocabulary and Grammar.
points: Where would you like to have the party?
When is the best time for the party?
If you could receive any present, what would you wish for?

You should write at least 250 words. Your response will be evaluated in terms of Task Fulfilment, Organization, Vocabulary and Grammar.

1.answer:
Dear Jenny,

Thank you for your email. It is kind of you to plan a party for my birthday.

Regarding the place, I would like to have the party at a coffee shop near my house in District 3. It is quiet and cozy, and it has a private room upstairs. We often meet there, so it feels like a second home.

As for the time, my birthday is on Friday, 4th December, but I usually work late on Fridays. How about holding the party on Saturday, 5th December, at 6 p.m.? Our friends are free at weekends, so everyone can stay longer. If this time does not suit you, just let me know.

About your question on a present, you do not need to buy me anything. However, if I could choose, I would wish for an e-book reader. I love reading, but paper books are heavy to carry. With it, I can read anywhere, even on the bus.

That's all for now. I am looking forward to seeing you at the party.

Best wishes,
Minh

2.essay_type: Advantages & disadvantages (thảo luận ưu điểm và nhược điểm)
2.answer:
Nowadays, more and more countries are using solar and wind power instead of coal and oil. Many people support this change, but others worry about its problems. This essay will discuss both the advantages and disadvantages of green energy.

On the one hand, green energy has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that it is expensive and not always stable. Building large solar farms and wind farms costs a lot of money. In addition, solar panels cannot produce electricity at night, and wind turbines stop when there is no wind. For example, many countries still need costly batteries or coal power plants as a backup. As a result, poorer countries may find it difficult to depend on green energy.

On the other hand, green energy brings two important benefits. Firstly, it is much cleaner than fossil fuels. This is because it uses sunlight and wind instead of burning coal. Solar panels and wind turbines do not produce smoke, so the air becomes cleaner and people have fewer health problems. For instance, cities with less coal power usually have fewer patients with breathing problems. Secondly, sunlight and wind will never run out. This means that countries can depend less on imported fuel. A good example is the south-central coast of Vietnam, where many solar farms have been built because of the strong sunshine. Thanks to this, local people also have more jobs.

In conclusion, green energy has both advantages and disadvantages. It is clean and will never run out, but it is still expensive and not always reliable. Therefore, governments should continue to invest in new technology to make it cheaper and more stable.

Dear Steve,

Thank you for your email. It was great to hear from you after such a long time.

Regarding my life, I am now a researcher at a university in Ho Chi Minh City. My team uses AI to help doctors read medical tests faster. I studied medicine before, so this job really suits me. Ho Chi Minh City is also my hometown, and it is a busy city with delicious street food.

As for my free time, I enjoy reading books and going to coffee shops with my friends. At weekends, I usually go swimming at a pool near my house. It helps me relax after a long week at work.

About your visit, I would love to meet you in Vietnam. How about meeting at Ben Thanh Market at 9 a.m. on the first Saturday of your trip? We can have breakfast there and then visit the War Remnants Museum. If this time does not suit you, just let me know.

2.answer:
Today, most workers carry a smartphone with them all day, and companies have very different rules about using it in the office. Some managers see phones as a useful tool, while others see them as a problem. This essay will discuss both the advantages and disadvantages of this habit.

On the one hand, using personal phones at work has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that phones can easily distract employees from their tasks. This is because many people keep checking social media and messages during working hours. For example, an office worker may spend ten minutes on Facebook every hour without noticing it. As a result, they finish their work more slowly, and the quality of their work may also go down.

On the other hand, personal phones bring two important benefits at work. Firstly, they help employees communicate quickly. The reason is that staff can answer colleagues and customers at any time, even when they are away from their desks. They do not need to wait until they are back at their computers. For instance, a salesperson can reply to a customer's question by message in just a few minutes. Secondly, phones allow workers to stay in touch with their families. This means that they feel less worried about problems at home. A good example is a parent who can check on a sick child during the lunch break. Thanks to this, they can focus better on their work.

In conclusion, using personal phones at work has both advantages and disadvantages. Phones may distract workers, but they also help them communicate quickly and stay in touch with their families. Therefore, companies should make clear rules instead of banning phones completely.

2.answer:
In this situation, among the three options, I think the effective communication skills course is the best choice for my brother. I choose it for two main reasons.

The first reason is that communication skills are useful in every job. By that, I mean my brother needs them every day when he talks to his boss, his colleagues and his customers. For example, if he can explain his ideas clearly in meetings, he will avoid misunderstandings and build good relationships at work.

Another reason is that communication is the foundation of other skills. In other words, a good presenter and a good manager must be good communicators first. For instance, after this course, he will find it much easier to learn presentation or management skills later.

There are also some reasons why I do not choose the other two options. Regarding the management skills course, I do not think it is the best choice because my brother is still a junior employee. He does not manage a team at the moment, so he cannot use these skills yet. As for the presentation skills course, I do not think it is the best option either because he only gives presentations a few times a year.

To sum up, out of these three options, I believe the effective communication skills course is the best choice because it is practical, useful and good for his whole career.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the uses of social media. In my opinion, social media is very useful in our daily lives.

Firstly, social media is a good source of entertainment. After a long day, many people want to relax and reduce stress. For example, I often watch funny videos or listen to music on YouTube in the evening.

Secondly, social media is very useful for doing business. Small sellers can reach a lot of customers without renting a shop, so they save money. For instance, my aunt sells coffee from Dak Lak on Facebook, and she has customers all over Vietnam.

Thirdly, people use social media to keep in touch with others. It is fast, cheap and easy to use. A good example is my cousin, who lives in Australia. We still call each other on Zalo every week for free.

Another important point is that social media is a great place for learning and getting information. Many pages share useful news and knowledge. For example, I follow several pages about health and technology, and I read them every morning.

To sum up, social media is useful for entertainment, business, keeping in touch and learning. However, we should use it wisely and not spend too much time on it.
follow_ups: Yes, I think many people spend too much time on social media. The main reason is that these apps are designed to keep us watching. For example, some of my friends check their phones every few minutes, even during meals. This can hurt their health and their relationships.

In my opinion, the biggest disadvantage is fake news. Many people believe wrong information without checking it. For instance, during the COVID-19 pandemic, a lot of fake health advice spread on Facebook. In addition, social media can make people feel lonely and stressed.

I think social media is more useful for young people. They use it to study, find jobs and make friends. For example, many students join online groups to share study materials. However, older people can also use it to keep in touch with their children.

2.answer:
In recent years, the air in many big cities has become more and more polluted and unsafe to breathe. In some places, people even need to wear a mask every time they go out. This essay will discuss the main causes of this trend and its effects.

There are two main causes of air pollution. Firstly, the number of private vehicles is growing quickly. Most of them burn petrol and release smoke into the air every day. For example, Ho Chi Minh City has millions of motorbikes, and the streets are full of smoke during rush hour. Secondly, many factories release harmful gases into the air. Some factory owners want to save money, so they do not use clean technology. For instance, factories in industrial zones often produce thick smoke all day and night.

This trend has two serious effects. The first effect is that dirty air harms people's health. It can cause breathing problems, heart disease and even lung cancer. A good example is young children and old people, who often have to go to hospital with coughs and asthma when the air is bad. In addition, people who are often sick cannot work or study well. Another effect is that air pollution damages the natural environment. Gases from cars and factories make the Earth warmer and cause acid rain. For example, acid rain can damage forests and kill fish in lakes. As a result, many plants and animals lose their homes.

In conclusion, air pollution is mainly caused by traffic and factories, and it harms both people's health and the natural environment. Therefore, people should use public transport more, and factories should switch to clean energy.

In this situation, among the three options, I think a cultural competition with prizes is the best choice for our school. I choose it for two main reasons.

The first reason is that a competition makes students active learners. By that, I mean they have to read about the pagoda, its history and its cultural value before they can take part. For example, teams can answer quiz questions or make posters about the pagoda's festivals and old buildings.

Another reason is that prizes motivate students. In other words, many students find history boring, but they still want to win. For instance, even small prizes, such as books or certificates, can make them excited to study. Students also work in teams, so they improve their teamwork skills.

There are also some reasons why I do not choose the other two options. Regarding a cultural festival, I do not think it is the best choice because students often focus on food, music and games. They have fun, but they may not learn much about the pagoda. As for a cultural event, I do not think it is the best option either because students often just sit and listen to a talk. They may feel bored and forget the information quickly.

To sum up, out of these three options, I believe a cultural competition with prizes is the best choice because it is fun, active and educational.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the effects of academic pressure on students. In my opinion, too much pressure can harm students in many ways.

Firstly, academic pressure leads to a lack of sleep. Many students study until midnight to finish their homework or prepare for exams. For example, my cousin in grade 12 often sleeps only five hours a night before her exams, so she feels tired in class.

Secondly, students under pressure often get angry easily. When they are tired and worried, small problems can make them upset. For instance, my cousin sometimes shouts at her younger brother just because he is a little noisy.

Thirdly, academic pressure leads to reduced social interaction. Students spend most of their time studying, so they have little time for friends and family. A good example is students who stop playing sports or meeting friends at weekends because they have extra classes.

Another important point is that academic pressure can cause mental health problems. Some students are always afraid of failing and disappointing their parents. For example, in serious cases, they may suffer from anxiety or depression and need help from a doctor.

To sum up, academic pressure can cause a lack of sleep, anger, less social interaction and mental health problems. Parents and teachers should support students and not expect too much from them.
follow_ups: I think the main cause is high expectations from parents. Many parents want their children to enter a top university and get a good job. For example, some parents compare their children's marks with their classmates' marks. In addition, students have to take many exams every year.

Students can deal with academic pressure by making a study plan and taking short breaks. This helps them study better and feel less stressed. For example, they can study for fifty minutes and then rest for ten minutes. If they feel very stressed, they should talk to their parents or a teacher.

Yes, I think some schools give too much homework. The main reason is that many students also go to extra classes in the evening. For example, my cousin often does homework until eleven o'clock at night. As a result, students have no time to rest, play or sleep well.

Dear Sarah,

Thank you for your email. It is lovely that you want to do something special for your parents.

Regarding the place, I think you should hold the party in a garden. A garden is more relaxed and romantic than a restaurant. Your parents love flowers, so they will enjoy it. However, please prepare a big tent in case it rains.

As for the activities, I would suggest showing a short video about your parents' life together. You can collect their old photos and add their favourite songs. Show it at 7 p.m. after dinner, and then ask them to dance to their wedding song.

About your question on helping, of course I can come one day early. If the party is on Saturday, I will arrive at your house at 9 a.m. on Friday. In the morning, we can buy flowers and balloons at the market. Then we can set up the tables and lights in the afternoon.

Best wishes,

2.answer:
Nowadays, artificial intelligence is growing very fast and is used in schools, hospitals, offices and even in films and games. Many people welcome this change, but others are worried about it. This essay will discuss both its advantages and disadvantages, but in my opinion, its benefits outweigh its drawbacks.

On the one hand, AI has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that it may take away some people's jobs. This is because machines can do simple and repeated tasks faster and more cheaply than humans. For example, many banks now use chatbots to answer customers' questions instead of hiring more staff. As a result, workers with low skills may find it harder to keep their jobs and need to learn new skills.

On the other hand, AI brings two important benefits. Firstly, it is very helpful in healthcare. The reason is that AI can check a large number of medical images in a short time and find small problems that people may miss. For instance, in my job, we use AI to help doctors read X-rays faster, so patients can start treatment sooner. Secondly, AI makes learning easier and more personal. This means that students can get help at any time, not only in class. A good example is an English learning app that corrects a student's pronunciation every day. Thanks to this, learners can improve quickly even without a private teacher.

In conclusion, AI has both advantages and disadvantages. Although it may replace some jobs, in my opinion, its benefits outweigh its drawbacks because it improves healthcare and learning. Therefore, governments should help workers learn new skills for the age of AI.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of learning foreign languages. In my opinion, a foreign language opens many doors in our lives.

Firstly, a foreign language gives us better career opportunities. Many international companies want to hire staff who can speak English, Japanese or Korean. For example, my friend got a job at a Korean company because she can speak Korean well.

Secondly, learning a language helps us understand other cultures. When we learn a language, we also learn about the people, their food and their customs. For instance, when I studied English, I learned a lot about Christmas and other Western festivals.

Thirdly, foreign languages are very useful for traveling and communication. We can ask for directions, order food and talk to local people easily. A good example is my trip to Singapore, where I used English everywhere and felt very confident.

Another important point is that a foreign language helps us get more knowledge. Many books, research papers and online courses are only in English. For example, in my job, I read medical articles in English every week to learn about new AI tools.

To sum up, learning foreign languages gives us better jobs, helps us understand other cultures, makes traveling easier and brings us more knowledge. I think everyone should learn at least one foreign language.
follow_ups: English is the most popular foreign language in Vietnam. The main reason is that it is an international language, and many companies require it. For example, most students start learning English at primary school. Recently, Korean and Japanese have also become popular because of films and jobs.

I think the best way is to practise a little every day. The main reason is that regular practice helps us remember words and speak more naturally. For example, learners can watch films with subtitles and talk with native speakers online. They should not be afraid of making mistakes.

I think children should start at about six years old. At this age, they can learn new sounds very quickly. For example, my niece started English in grade one, and now her pronunciation is very good. However, parents should make learning fun and not put too much pressure on them.

2.answer:
Today, the Internet allows people to meet new friends from all over the world without leaving home. Many users now have lots of online friends, but they have never seen most of them face to face. This essay will discuss both the advantages and disadvantages of this trend.

On the one hand, having many online friends has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that some online friends are not who they say they are. This is because anyone can create a fake profile with a false name and photo. For example, some people pretend to be young and friendly, and later they ask teenagers for money or private photos. As a result, young users can lose money or even be in danger.

On the other hand, online friends bring two important benefits. Firstly, they help people learn about other cultures and languages. The reason is that people can chat every day with friends from different countries. For instance, a Vietnamese student can practise English with a friend in Canada and learn about Canadian festivals at the same time. Secondly, online friends can give support to people with uncommon problems. This means that people do not feel alone, even if nobody around them understands their situation. A good example is patients with a rare illness, who can share their feelings and advice in online groups. Thanks to this, they feel stronger and less lonely.

In conclusion, having a lot of online friends has both advantages and disadvantages. It helps people learn about the world and get support, but it can also put them at risk. Therefore, we should enjoy online friendships but be careful with strangers.

The first reason is that swimming is an important life skill. By that, I mean many students in Vietnam still cannot swim, so they are in danger near rivers and the sea. For example, with a pool on campus, the university can offer cheap swimming lessons to first-year students.

Another reason is that swimming is good for almost everyone. In other words, students of all ages and fitness levels can enjoy it, and it rarely causes injuries. There are also some reasons why I do not choose the other two options. Regarding a gym, I do not think it is the best choice because there are already many cheap gyms near the university. As for a football field, I do not think it is the best option either because it needs a lot of land. Also, only about twenty people can play at one time.

To sum up, out of these three options, I believe a swimming pool is the best choice because it is useful, healthy and suitable for everyone.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the importance of work-life balance. In my opinion, a good balance between work and personal life makes us healthier and happier.

Firstly, I want to explain why it is important. When we have time to rest, exercise and see our families, we feel less stressed and can work better. For example, after swimming at the weekend, I always feel fresh and full of energy on Monday morning.

Secondly, poor balance causes many problems. People who work too much often feel tired and stressed, and they have little time for their families. For instance, a doctor friend of mine worked every weekend for a year, and she got sick and felt far from her children.

Thirdly, there are some simple ways to achieve balance. We should plan our time carefully and stop checking work emails at night. A good example is my own rule, which is never to answer work messages on Sundays.

Another important point is that work-life balance also brings benefits for companies. Happy employees work harder, make fewer mistakes and stay longer with the company. For example, my university gives staff flexible hours, and very few people in my team have left.

To sum up, work-life balance keeps us healthy, helps us avoid many problems, and is easy to achieve with simple habits. It is also good for companies, so both workers and employers should care about it.
follow_ups: I think many people find it difficult because they have too much work and tight deadlines. In addition, smartphones make it easy to check work emails at any time. For example, my friends often reply to their bosses late at night. As a result, work follows them home.

Companies can help in several ways. The most important thing is to offer flexible working hours. For example, a parent can start work early and leave early to pick up the children. Companies should also avoid sending messages to staff after work.

Yes, I think working from home helps in some ways. The main reason is that people save time because they do not travel to work. For example, I can use that time to cook breakfast or go swimming. However, some people find it hard to stop working because their office is also their home.

Dear Ms Taylor,

I am writing in response to your email about the English teaching position at our center.

Concerning the qualifications, you need a bachelor's degree in English or English language teaching. You also need a teaching certificate, such as CELTA or TESOL. In addition, we prefer candidates with at least one year of teaching experience.

With regard to your students, you will mainly teach children between the ages of seven and twelve. This is because most of our learners are primary school pupils. However, you may also teach one adult class on Saturday mornings.

Regarding your timetable, you will teach about twenty lessons per week, and each lesson lasts ninety minutes. As for outdoor activities, we organise them once a month. For example, students visit a park or a museum and practise English with their teachers there.

If you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me. I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,
Nguyen Minh

2.answer:
In recent years, more and more young workers are moving from one company to another after a short time. This trend, called job hopping, is now very common in many countries. This essay will discuss the main causes of this trend and its effects on both workers and companies.

There are two main causes of job hopping. Firstly, many young employees want a higher salary. Often, the quickest way to get a big pay rise is to move to a new company. For example, a software engineer may get a much better offer from another firm after only one year. Secondly, young people want to learn new skills and find the right career. They try different jobs to discover what they really enjoy. For instance, my friend worked in sales and marketing before she finally chose to become a teacher.

This trend has two serious effects. The first effect is that job hopping can hurt workers' careers in the long term. Some employers think that job hoppers are not loyal, so they may not hire them for senior positions. A good example is a CV with five jobs in four years, which may worry a manager. Another effect is that companies lose time and money. When an experienced worker leaves, the company has to find and train a new person. For example, a small restaurant may need several weeks to train a new cook. As a result, the quality of work may go down for a while.

In conclusion, job hopping is mainly caused by the wish for higher pay and the need to find the right career. It can hurt workers' careers and cost companies a lot of time and money.

Today I would like to talk about the benefits of keeping pets. In my opinion, pets can make our lives happier and healthier.

Firstly, pets give us companionship. People who live alone, such as old people or students, often feel lonely, and a pet can be a good friend for them. For example, my grandmother lives alone in Da Nang, and her cat keeps her company all day.

Secondly, pets give us emotional support. They love us without judging us, so they help us feel calm when we are sad or stressed. For instance, when I come home after a stressful day, my dog, Lucky, runs to me and wags his tail, and I feel happy again.

Thirdly, keeping pets has health benefits. Dog owners have to walk their dogs every day, so they get more exercise. A good example is my neighbour, who walks his dog in the park every morning and has lost some weight.

Another important point is that pets can teach children responsibility. When children feed and clean their pets, they learn to take care of others. For example, my nephew has to feed his fish every day before school.

To sum up, pets give us companionship, emotional support, health benefits and important lessons for children. However, before we get a pet, we should make sure we have enough time to look after it.
follow_ups: In Ho Chi Minh City, most people keep dogs and cats. The main reason is that dogs can protect the house and cats can catch mice. For example, my neighbours have a big dog that barks when strangers come. People who live in small flats often keep fish or birds because they need less space.

Keeping a pet can cause several problems for its owner. The biggest problem is that pets need a lot of money, time and care. For example, food and vet bills can be expensive, especially when a pet gets sick. In addition, some pets make noise or make the house dirty.

Yes, I think children should have pets. The main reason is that pets teach them to be responsible and kind. For example, a child who walks a dog every day learns to keep a routine. However, parents should help them and choose a safe and gentle pet.

2.answer:
In recent years, the amount of plastic rubbish in our rivers, oceans and landfills has grown very quickly. Since plastic stays in nature for a very long time, it is a serious threat to the planet. This essay will discuss the main effects of this issue and suggest some solutions.

There are two main effects of dumping plastic waste. Firstly, plastic kills a lot of sea animals and birds. This is because they often mistake plastic for food. For example, sea turtles eat plastic bags because these bags look like jellyfish, and many of them die. Secondly, plastic pollutes our land, water and even our food. When plastic breaks into tiny pieces, these pieces enter the soil, rivers and seas. For instance, scientists have found tiny bits of plastic inside fish and sea salt. As a result, this plastic can get into our bodies and harm our health.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, governments should make strict laws to reduce single-use plastic. This means that less plastic will end up in the sea and harm wildlife. A good example is a ban on free plastic bags in supermarkets. Secondly, companies and individuals should recycle more and use other materials. For example, some supermarkets in Vietnam now wrap vegetables in banana leaves instead of plastic, and many shoppers bring their own cloth bags. Thanks to this, less plastic will break down into our soil, water and food.

In conclusion, dumping plastic waste harms wildlife and pollutes our land, water and food. However, this problem can be reduced if governments make strict laws and people recycle more. If everyone makes small changes, our environment will become cleaner and safer.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the factors that affect people's choice of jobs. In my opinion, people think about many things before they accept a job.

Firstly, salary is a very important factor. Everyone needs money to pay for food, rent and other bills. For example, many young people choose jobs in banks or IT companies because these jobs usually pay well.

Secondly, people care about the working environment. A safe, clean and modern workplace makes workers feel comfortable and work better. For instance, many people prefer an office with flexible working hours to a noisy factory with long shifts.

Thirdly, colleagues and the boss also affect people's choices. Friendly colleagues help each other, and a good boss gives clear instructions and praises good work. A good example is my own job, which I chose partly because my team leader is kind and supportive.

Another important point is that people want a job that matches their personal interests. When people love their work, they work harder and feel happier. For example, I studied medicine and I love technology, so I chose a job that uses AI to help doctors.

To sum up, salary, the working environment, colleagues and the boss, and personal interests all affect people's choice of jobs. A good job should have a balance of these factors.
follow_ups: I think young people care about salary the most. The main reason is that living costs in big cities are very high. For example, many of my younger friends have to pay rent and send money to their parents. They also want to save money to buy a house in the future.

I think office jobs and IT jobs are the most popular in Vietnam. Many young people want to work in technology because the salary is high and the work is modern. For example, a lot of my cousins studied computer science at university. Teaching and nursing are also common jobs.

I think people should choose a job they love. The main reason is that they will work hard and become good at it. For example, a doctor who loves helping patients will keep learning every year. As a result, they can often earn a good salary later.

Nowadays, social networks such as Facebook and TikTok are part of daily life for a huge number of people. These apps have changed how we talk, study and relax, but they also cause some worries. This essay will discuss both the advantages and disadvantages of social media.

On the one hand, social media has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that it can be very addictive. This is because these apps are designed to keep users scrolling for as long as possible. For example, many teenagers watch short videos on TikTok until midnight, even before an important exam. As a result, they sleep badly, feel tired in class and have less time for studying and for their real friends.

On the other hand, social media brings two important benefits. Firstly, it helps people stay in touch with friends and family who live far away. The reason is that video calls and messages on these apps are fast and free. For instance, I can call my cousin in Australia on Facebook every weekend without paying anything. This makes us feel close to each other even though we live far apart. Secondly, social media is a useful place to learn new things. This means that people can get knowledge at any time and in any place. A good example is doctors who share short videos about healthy eating and first aid. Thanks to this, many people can learn how to take better care of their health.

In conclusion, social media has both advantages and disadvantages. It can make people addicted, but it also helps them keep in touch with others and learn new things. Therefore, we should use it wisely and limit our screen time.

Today I would like to talk about the reasons why misbehavior among young people is increasing. In my opinion, there are several main reasons for this problem.

Firstly, family background plays an important role. Many parents are very busy with work, so they do not spend enough time with their children. For example, some children are left alone with a phone all evening, and nobody teaches them right from wrong.

Secondly, school discipline is sometimes not strict enough. In some schools, the rules are not clear, and bad behavior is not punished. For instance, if a student skips class and nothing happens, other students may do the same.

Thirdly, the Internet has strong effects on young people. Many teenagers watch violent videos or play violent games online, and some of them copy what they see. A good example is students who copy dangerous challenges from TikTok and hurt themselves or others.

Another important point is that peer pressure can push young people to behave badly. Teenagers want to be accepted by their friends. For example, if a group of friends smokes or fights, a teenager may do the same things to fit in.

To sum up, family background, weak school discipline, the effects of the Internet and peer pressure all lead to more misbehavior. Parents, schools and society should work together to guide young people.
follow_ups: Parents can help by spending more time talking with their children. When children feel loved and listened to, they are less likely to behave badly. For example, parents can have dinner together every evening and ask about their day at school. They should also set clear rules at home.

Yes, I think schools should punish students who misbehave, but the punishment should be fair and not violent. The main reason is that students need to learn to take responsibility for their actions. For example, a student can clean the classroom or write a letter of apology.

I think the government should play an important role. It should make strict laws against harmful content and ask social media companies to remove violent videos quickly. For example, it can fine companies that do not delete dangerous challenges. It can also teach young people how to use the Internet safely.

2.answer:
People have different opinions on whether young people should find their own husband or wife or let their families choose for them. This essay will discuss both views, but I believe that a marriage based on love is a better choice.

On the one hand, some people believe that arranged marriages are more likely to last. This is because parents and relatives have more life experience than young people. They can judge whether a person is honest, hard-working and responsible. For example, in my grandparents' generation, many couples in Vietnam were introduced by their families, and they lived happily together for fifty years. As a result, these people think that family help can protect young people from bad choices.

On the other hand, I agree with those who think that young people should choose their own partners. Firstly, a happy marriage needs love and understanding. When two people choose each other, they usually know each other's personalities and habits well before the wedding. For instance, my cousin dated her husband for three years, so they already knew how to solve problems together. Secondly, marriage is a lifelong decision, so the couple should have the right to make it. In other words, parents cannot live their children's lives for them. A good example is a woman who marries a rich man only to please her parents and later feels unhappy every day. Therefore, a love marriage usually brings more happiness to the couple.

In conclusion, although parents' experience can be helpful, I believe that young people should choose their own partners because marriage needs love and it is their own life. However, it is still wise to listen to their families' advice before the final decision.

Today I would like to talk about some solutions to reduce obesity. In my opinion, small changes in our daily habits can help us keep a healthy weight.

Firstly, people should eat less fast food. Fast food, such as fried chicken, burgers and sugary drinks, has a lot of fat, sugar and salt. For example, instead of eating chips after school, students can eat fresh fruit or nuts as healthy snacks.

Secondly, cooking meals at home is a good idea. When we cook at home, we can choose fresh ingredients and use less oil and sugar. For instance, my family usually cooks rice, fish and vegetables for dinner, and this meal is both healthy and cheap.

Thirdly, people should do more exercise. Exercise helps us burn calories and keeps our hearts strong. For example, I go swimming every weekend, and it helps me stay fit and relaxed after a long week.

Another important point is that people should get enough sleep. When we are tired, we often feel hungry and want to eat sweet snacks. A good example is office workers who stay up late and eat instant noodles at midnight.

To sum up, eating less fast food, cooking meals at home, doing more exercise and getting enough sleep can help reduce obesity. These changes are simple, but they can make a big difference to our health.
follow_ups: I think obesity is becoming more common because our lifestyle has changed. Fast food and sugary drinks are cheap and easy to buy everywhere. In addition, many people sit in offices all day and spend their free time on their phones. For example, my colleagues and I often sit for hours without moving.

I think individuals should be more responsible because they choose what to eat every day. However, the government can also help a lot. For example, it can build more parks and teach children about healthy eating at school. Both sides need to work together.

Yes, I think a tax would help a little. The main reason is that people usually buy less when things are more expensive. For example, if a bottle of soft drink costs more, students may choose water instead. However, the government should also make healthy food cheaper.

Hi Lucy,

Thank you for your email. I am so happy that you are planning to visit Ho Chi Minh City.

Regarding the best time to visit, I think you should come between December and April. This is the dry season, so it rarely rains. If you come in late January or February, you can also enjoy Tet, our Lunar New Year.

As for things to see and do, you can visit Ben Thanh Market and the War Remnants Museum. In the evening, you should walk along Nguyen Hue Walking Street and try street food such as banh mi. You can also take a day trip to the Cu Chi Tunnels.

About your question on travel and accommodation, the easiest way to get here is by plane. You can fly to Tan Son Nhat Airport and then take a Grab car to the city centre. I suggest staying at a hotel in District 1 because many famous places are within walking distance.

That's all for now. I can show you around on Saturday morning.

Best wishes,
Minh

2.answer:
Nowadays, tourism is growing fast in many parts of the world, and many new hotels and resorts are appearing in famous places. This brings more money to local people, but it can also damage nature and the landscape. This essay will discuss both its advantages and disadvantages.

On the one hand, tourism development brings one main benefit to local residents. The biggest advantage is that it creates jobs and increases their income. This is because tourists need places to stay, food to eat and guides to show them around. For example, many families in Hoi An now earn a good living by running homestays, cooking for visitors or selling souvenirs. As a result, their living standards improve, and they can afford to send their children to better schools.

On the other hand, tourism development causes two serious problems. Firstly, it pollutes the natural environment. Large numbers of visitors create a lot of rubbish, waste water and noise every day. For instance, some beaches become very dirty after busy holidays, and coral reefs are damaged by boats and divers. Secondly, it can ruin the beauty of the landscape. The reason is that many hotels and resorts are built in natural areas, so forests and hills are cleared. A good example is the coast of Nha Trang, where tall hotels now block the sea view in many places. Therefore, these places may slowly lose the natural beauty that attracted tourists in the first place.

In conclusion, tourism development has both advantages and disadvantages. It gives local residents more jobs and higher income, but it can also pollute the environment and spoil the beautiful landscape.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the importance of face-to-face communication. In my opinion, even in the digital age, meeting people in person is still very important.

Firstly, face-to-face communication helps us build trust and relationships. When we meet someone in person, we can shake hands, smile and look into their eyes. For example, I always feel closer to my friends after we have coffee together.

Secondly, it helps us understand body language and emotions. We can see the other person's face and hear their voice, so we know how they really feel. For instance, the doctors in my project say that meeting patients in person helps them notice when a patient is worried.

Thirdly, face-to-face communication helps us avoid misunderstandings. Text messages can be short and unclear, but in person we can ask questions immediately. A good example is a short reply like "OK", which can sound angry in a text but friendly with a smile.

Another important point is that face-to-face communication leads to better teamwork. Team members can share ideas quickly and solve problems together. For example, my team has a short meeting every Monday morning, and it helps us plan our work much better.

To sum up, face-to-face communication is important because it builds trust, helps us understand emotions, avoids misunderstandings and improves teamwork.
follow_ups: Yes, I think so. The main reason is that smartphones make online communication fast and easy. For example, my relatives often send messages on Zalo instead of visiting each other. Even colleagues in the same office sometimes chat online rather than walk to each other's desks.

The biggest disadvantage is that online messages can be short and unclear. The reason is that we cannot see the other person's face or body language. For example, a joke in a message may sound rude and cause an argument. In addition, people may feel lonely if they only talk online.

Face-to-face communication is better for important conversations. The main reason is that we need to see people's faces and feelings in these situations. For example, job interviews, sharing bad news and visiting a doctor should happen in person. Meeting face to face also shows more respect and care.

2.answer:
Nowadays, smartphones and the Internet are everywhere, so many people pay by QR code, e-wallet or banking app rather than with notes and coins. This change makes daily life easier, but it also worries some people. This essay will discuss both its advantages and disadvantages.

On the one hand, cashless payment has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that it can make people easy targets for online fraud. This is because criminals send fake messages and links to steal passwords and money from bank accounts. For example, an elderly man may receive a message that looks like it comes from his bank and type in his OTP code. As a result, he can lose a lot of money in a few minutes and may never get it back.

On the other hand, cashless payment brings two important benefits. Firstly, it is very fast and convenient. People only need their phones to pay for almost anything, so they do not have to carry a thick wallet. For instance, I can pay for a coffee, a Grab ride or a parking ticket by scanning a QR code in just a few seconds. Secondly, cashless payment helps people manage their money better. The reason is that banking apps record every payment automatically. A good example is a student who checks her app each month and sees that she spends too much on milk tea. Thanks to this, users can plan their spending and save more money.

In conclusion, cashless payment has both advantages and disadvantages. It is fast and helps people manage their money, but users must be careful because of online fraud.

Today I would like to talk about the reasons why young people lose their jobs. In my opinion, most of these reasons come from their attitude and their preparation.

Firstly, some young people have a bad attitude at work. They come to work late, complain a lot or do not respect their colleagues. For example, a new employee who often refuses extra tasks may soon lose the manager's trust.

Secondly, many young people lack the skills that companies need. At university, they learn a lot of theory but get little practical experience. For instance, some graduates cannot write a clear email or work well in a team.

Thirdly, some young people have unrealistic salary expectations. They want a high salary from the first day, even though they do not have enough experience. A good example is a graduate who stops trying because the company does not give him a pay rise after three months.

Another important point is that poor time management can also cause job loss. Some young employees spend too much time on their phones and miss deadlines. For example, if a worker is late with reports many times, the company may decide to let him go.

To sum up, young people lose their jobs because of a bad attitude, a lack of skills, unrealistic salary expectations and poor time management.
follow_ups: Young people can avoid losing their jobs by having a positive attitude and always being on time. The main reason is that managers value reliable and hard-working staff. For example, a worker who finishes tasks on time and helps colleagues is rarely let go. They should also take short online courses to learn new skills.

No, I do not think so. The main reason is that many schools focus too much on theory and exams. For example, many students graduate without ever writing a CV or doing an internship. Schools should offer more practical training, such as group projects and work experience.

Employers can give young employees clear goals and regular feedback. The reason is that new staff often do not know exactly what their managers expect. For example, a company can give each new employee a mentor, who is an experienced colleague. Short training courses can also help them improve quickly.

2.answer:
Nowadays, many people take their laptops to coffee shops or parks to work and study, rather than staying at the office or at home. Some find this relaxing and effective, while others see problems. This essay will discuss both its advantages and disadvantages.

On the one hand, working in public places has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that these places are often noisy and full of distractions. This is because there is loud music, and other customers talk or make phone calls. For example, a student who is writing an essay in a busy coffee shop may have to read the same paragraph many times. As a result, it takes longer to finish difficult tasks, and the work may contain more mistakes.

On the other hand, working in public places brings two important benefits. Firstly, a new environment can make people feel more creative and motivated. The reason is that sitting in the same office or bedroom every day can feel boring. For instance, a designer may get fresh ideas when she sits in a park and looks at the trees. Secondly, people feel less lonely when they work around others. This means that people who work from home can still see other faces and have small conversations during the day. A good example is a freelance translator who goes to a coffee shop every afternoon to feel more connected. Thanks to this, such workers stay happier and more productive.

In conclusion, working in public places has both advantages and disadvantages. Noise can make it hard to focus, but a new environment can help people feel more creative and less lonely.

Today I would like to talk about the advantages of electric vehicles. In my opinion, electric vehicles are a smart choice for the future, especially in big cities.

Firstly, electric vehicles help to protect the environment. They do not produce exhaust fumes, so the air in big cities becomes cleaner. For example, if more people in Ho Chi Minh City used electric motorbikes, there would be less smoke on busy roads.

Secondly, electric vehicles have lower running costs. Charging a battery is much cheaper than buying petrol, and the motor needs fewer repairs. For instance, my friend has an electric car, and he says he spends much less on fuel than before.

Thirdly, drivers can gain a better driving experience. Electric cars speed up quickly and run very smoothly. A good example is my first ride in an electric car, which felt quiet and comfortable even in heavy traffic.

Another important point is that electric vehicles help to reduce noise pollution. Their motors are very quiet, so the streets become more peaceful. For example, people who live near busy roads can sleep and work better.

To sum up, electric vehicles are useful because they protect the environment, save money, give a better driving experience and reduce noise.
follow_ups: Yes, I think they are better in many ways. The main reason is that they are cleaner, quieter and cheaper to run. For example, charging an electric motorbike costs much less than filling it with petrol. However, gasoline vehicles are still better for long trips because petrol stations are everywhere.

The biggest disadvantage is that electric vehicles are usually more expensive to buy. Another problem is that there are not many charging stations in some areas. For example, if you drive from Ho Chi Minh City to a small town, you may not find a place to charge. Charging also takes a long time.

Governments can reduce taxes on electric vehicles, so they become cheaper. The main reason is that high prices stop many people from buying them. Governments should also build more charging stations in cities and on highways. For example, every petrol station could have a few charging points.

I am writing in response to your email about including my hometown, Da Nang, in your new tour.

2.answer:
In recent years, more and more Vietnamese people are using the Internet for shopping, banking and working. However, criminals also use it to steal money and personal data. This essay will discuss the main problems of this issue and suggest some solutions.

There are two main problems caused by cybercrime. Firstly, it harms individuals both financially and mentally. This is because victims can lose their savings in just a few minutes. For example, an elderly woman may click on a link in a fake bank message and give away her password. As a result, she loses her money and becomes afraid of using online services. Secondly, cybercrime damages businesses and society. When hackers attack a company's system, customers' personal data can be leaked and sold. For instance, after a data leak at an online shop, many customers may stop buying from it. Therefore, people lose trust in online services, and the digital economy grows more slowly.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, banks and the media should teach people how to stay safe online. They can explain how to recognise fake websites and phishing messages. A good example is a short video on TV that reminds elderly people never to share their passwords or OTP codes. Secondly, the government and companies should work together to protect personal data. The government should punish cybercriminals more heavily, and companies should improve their security systems. For example, online shops can use two-step login and update their software regularly. Thanks to this, criminals will find it harder to steal data and money.

In conclusion, cybercrime causes financial and emotional harm to individuals and damages trust in businesses. However, this problem can be reduced if people learn how to stay safe online and the government and companies protect personal data better.

Today I would like to talk about using mobile phones at school. In my opinion, phones can be useful at school, but students need clear rules.

Firstly, mobile phones have many benefits for learning. Students can look up new words, watch educational videos and use learning apps. For example, my nephew uses an app to practise English for fifteen minutes after class every day.

Secondly, phones can cause distractions in class. Some students play games or check social media while the teacher is speaking. For instance, a student who reads messages during a maths lesson may miss the new formula and get a lower mark.

Thirdly, phones are important for safety and communication. Parents can contact their children quickly if there is a problem. A good example is my niece, who called her mother when she felt sick at school.

Another important point is that using phones too much can affect students' health. If students look at screens for too long, they may have eye problems and headaches. For example, some teenagers use their phones late at night, so they feel tired in class the next morning.

To sum up, mobile phones can help students learn and stay safe, but they can also cause distractions and health problems. Schools should make clear rules so that students use them wisely.
follow_ups: I think schools should allow phones only for learning activities. The main reason is that phones can be useful, but they are also very distracting. For example, teachers can let students search for information during a group project. At other times, phones should stay in students' bags.

Teachers can make clear rules about when students can use their phones. The reason is that students need to know the limits. For example, phones can be used only in the last ten minutes of a lesson for a quiz app. Teachers should also be good examples and not use their own phones in class.

I think children should have their own phones at about twelve or thirteen. The main reason is that at this age, many of them start to go to school alone. For example, they may need to call their parents when classes finish late. However, parents should still check which apps they use.

2.answer:
Nowadays, many cities keep roads, buildings and advertising boards bright all night. This extra light harms human health and wild animals, and it hides the stars from our view. This essay will discuss the main solutions to this problem.

To begin with, governments can reduce light pollution in two ways. Firstly, they should replace old street lights with modern lights that point down to the ground. This means that less light goes up into the sky. For example, a city can use LED street lights with covers on top, so the light only shines on the road. Secondly, governments should make laws about advertising signs. The reason is that many big signs stay on all night, even when the streets are empty. For instance, shops and companies could be asked to turn off their signs after 11 p.m. As a result, cities will be darker at night and save a lot of energy.

In addition, individuals can also help to solve this problem. One important point is that people should turn off lights they do not need. Many families leave garden or balcony lights on all night. For example, a family can use a timer, so the outdoor lights switch off at midnight. Another point is that people can close their curtains at night and choose softer light bulbs. This keeps the light inside the home and also helps people sleep better. A good example is my own family, who now use warm yellow bulbs in the living room. Thanks to this, there is less light outside, and our electricity bills are lower.

In conclusion, both governments and individuals can take simple steps to reduce light pollution. Governments should improve street lights and control advertising signs, while people should turn off unnecessary lights and use softer bulbs.

Today I would like to talk about the causes of obesity in children. In my opinion, this problem mainly comes from children's daily habits.

Firstly, many children have unhealthy eating habits. They eat a lot of fast food, sweets and soft drinks, which have too much sugar and fat. For example, many students buy fried snacks and milk tea outside the school gate every afternoon.

Secondly, many children today do not get enough physical activity. In big cities, there are not many parks, and children spend most of the day at school or in extra classes. For instance, my nephew studies from morning until evening, so he has no time to play sports.

Thirdly, children have too much screen time. They watch cartoons or play video games for hours, and they often eat snacks at the same time. A good example is a child who plays games all weekend and hardly moves at all.

Another important point is that many parents are too busy to cook healthy meals. They work long hours, so they often buy fast food for dinner. For example, some busy parents order fried chicken through a delivery app several times a week.

To sum up, childhood obesity is caused by unhealthy eating habits, a lack of physical activity, too much screen time and busy parents. Families and schools should work together to solve it.
follow_ups: I think both should be responsible, but parents play a bigger role. The main reason is that children eat most of their meals at home. For example, parents decide what food to buy and cook every day. Schools can help by teaching children about healthy food and offering sports classes.

Parents can cook healthy meals at home with lots of vegetables and fruit. The reason is that children usually eat what is available at home. For example, parents should not keep sweets or soft drinks in the fridge. They can also cook together with their children to make healthy food fun.

Yes, I think so. The main reason is that children cannot always make good choices, and these adverts make fast food look very attractive. For example, many TV adverts show happy children with free toys in their meals. If there are fewer adverts, children will ask for fast food less often.

2.answer:
People have different opinions on whether schools should keep paper textbooks or switch to tablets and e-readers. Some want to keep the old books, while others prefer a fully digital classroom. This essay will discuss both views, but I believe that printed textbooks should stay.

On the one hand, some people believe that digital textbooks should completely replace printed ones. This is because one tablet can store hundreds of books and also include videos and exercises. Digital books are also easy to update when new information appears. For example, a biology lesson on a tablet can show a short video about how the heart works. As a result, students may find lessons more interesting, and their school bags become much lighter.

On the other hand, I agree with those who think that printed textbooks are still necessary. Firstly, paper books are better for students' health. Looking at a screen for many hours can cause tired eyes and headaches. For instance, during the COVID-19 pandemic, many children studied online all day and often complained about eye pain. Paper books, in contrast, do not cause this problem. Secondly, printed books help students focus on the lesson. The reason is that a tablet makes it very easy to open games or social media. A good example is a student who seems to be reading on his tablet but is actually chatting with friends. Therefore, paper books are a safer choice for learning in class.

In conclusion, although digital textbooks are light and interesting, I believe that schools should keep printed textbooks because they protect students' eyes and help them focus. Tablets can still be used for extra videos at home.

Today I would like to talk about the benefits of traveling in a group. In my opinion, group travel is cheaper, safer and more fun than traveling alone.

Firstly, traveling in a group helps us share costs and reduce travel expenses. We can share a hotel room, a taxi or a big meal. For example, last year I went to Da Lat with four friends, and we rented a whole house for a very good price.

Secondly, we feel safer and more supported during the trip. If someone gets lost or sick, the others can help right away. For instance, when my friend had a stomachache in Hoi An, we took him to a clinic quickly.

Thirdly, group travel creates shared memories and stronger friendships. We eat, play and solve problems together. A good example is our trip to Phu Quoc, which we still talk about every time we meet.

Another important point is that we can learn from each other on the trip. Each person has different knowledge and skills. For example, one friend may be good at planning, and another may know a lot about local food and history.

To sum up, traveling in a group is a great choice because of lower costs, more safety, stronger friendships and learning from each other.
follow_ups: I think the main advantage is that group travel is cheaper. The reason is that we can share the costs of hotels, taxis and food. For example, a room for four people costs much less per person than a single room. It is also safer and more fun.

Yes, there are some disadvantages. The main reason is that it can be hard to agree on where to go and what to do. For example, on one trip, half of my group wanted to go shopping, but the others wanted to go hiking. We wasted a lot of time arguing.

I think group traveling is more suitable for young people. The main reason is that they usually have less money, so sharing costs is very helpful. For example, many students travel in big groups to save money on transport and hotels. They also enjoy making new friends.

Hi Coral,

Thank you for your email. I am happy to answer your questions about the meeting.

Regarding the venue, I recommend the meeting room at the Rex Hotel in the city centre. It is modern and quiet, and it has a good projector. The hotel is also close to many restaurants, so lunch is easy. I suggest booking it for Tuesday from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. because it is often busy later in the week.

As for the cost, it is about 600,000 dong per person, which is around 23 US dollars. This price includes the room, morning coffee and a buffet lunch. If your group is large, you can ask for a small discount.

About your question on payment, you can pay online. The hotel accepts bank transfers and credit cards when you book. However, you should bring a little cash because some taxis and most street food stalls only take cash.

That's all for now. I am looking forward to seeing you next week.

Best wishes,
Minh

2.answer:
In recent years, many children have spent hours on phones, tablets and computer games rather than playing outside or reading. Parents and teachers worry that this habit is bad for their bodies and their social skills. This essay will discuss the main causes of this issue and suggest some solutions.

There are two main causes of this issue. Firstly, many parents are too busy with work to play with their children. This means that they often give their children a tablet to keep them quiet. For example, many young children watch cartoons on a phone in restaurants. As a result, children get used to screens very early and spend less time talking to people. Secondly, big cities do not have enough safe places for children to play. This is because most land is used for houses, shops and roads. For instance, many children in Ho Chi Minh City live in small flats far from any park. Therefore, they stay indoors, play video games and get little exercise.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, parents should set clear rules about screen time and spend more time with their children. A good example is a family that turns off all devices after dinner and reads books together. As a result, children enjoy reading and talking again. Secondly, local governments and schools should create more places and activities for outdoor play. For example, they can build small playgrounds in every neighbourhood and open school sports fields at weekends. Thanks to this, children can stay active and make friends.

In conclusion, children use electronic devices too much mainly because their parents are busy and cities lack safe play areas. However, this problem can be reduced if parents set clear screen rules and local governments provide more outdoor activities.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of travelling. In my opinion, travelling is one of the best ways to learn and grow.

Firstly, travelling helps us experience new cultures. We can try local food, see traditional festivals and learn how people live. For example, when I visited Thailand, I learned how Thai people show respect to monks and older people.

Secondly, we can learn new skills when we travel. We have to plan the trip, read maps and manage our money by ourselves. For instance, on my trip to Singapore, I practised my English every day when I asked for directions.

Thirdly, travelling helps us gain more life experience. Sometimes we miss a bus or lose our way, and we have to solve the problem ourselves. A good example is my first trip alone to Da Nang, when I lost my phone but still found my way back to the hotel.

Another important point is that travelling helps us relax and reduce stress. After months of hard work, a short trip gives us new energy. For example, after a weekend at Vung Tau beach, I always feel refreshed when I go back to work.

To sum up, travelling is very useful because of new cultures, new skills, more life experience and less stress. That is why I try to travel at least twice a year.
follow_ups: My most memorable trip was to Da Lat with my university friends three years ago. The main reason is that it was simple but full of fun. For example, we stayed in a small wooden house and drank hot coffee in the cool morning air. We still talk about that trip today.

I would rather travel with my friends. The main reason is that we have similar interests, so we can do exciting activities together. For example, last summer we went hiking and camping in Bao Loc. However, I also enjoy short trips with my family during Tet.

I would choose a standard tour. The main reason is that it is cheaper, and I do not need a luxury hotel because I spend most of my time outside. For example, on my last trip, I saved money on the hotel and spent it on local food and activities.

2.answer:
In recent years, cheap and trendy clothes have become very popular, but making them harms our planet. The fashion industry now produces a large share of the world's greenhouse gases. This essay will discuss the main causes of this issue and the problems it creates, and suggest some solutions.

There are two main causes of this problem. Firstly, fashion brands produce huge amounts of cheap clothes very quickly. This is because they want to follow new trends and make more profit. For example, some brands bring new designs to their shops every week. As a result, factories use a lot of water, energy and chemicals, which pollute rivers and the air. Secondly, many consumers buy too many clothes and throw them away quickly. This means that clothes are worn only a few times. For instance, many young people buy cheap T-shirts online during sales and stop wearing them after one season. Therefore, huge amounts of textile waste end up in landfills.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, governments should make fashion companies use cleaner production methods. For instance, they can fine factories that pour dirty water into rivers and give tax cuts to brands that use recycled materials. Secondly, consumers should buy fewer but better clothes and reuse them. A good example is buying second-hand clothes or giving old clothes to charity instead of throwing them away. Thanks to this, less textile waste is produced.

In conclusion, fast fashion harms the environment mainly because brands produce too many clothes and consumers throw them away too quickly. However, this problem can be reduced if governments control factories more strictly and people change their shopping habits.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the factors contributing to childhood obesity in modern society. In my opinion, this problem has several causes, and most of them come from our modern lifestyle.

Firstly, unhealthy eating habits are a major cause. Many children eat fast food, sweets and soft drinks almost every day. For example, many students buy fried chicken and bubble tea after school instead of eating fruit.

Secondly, a lack of physical activity and too much screen time make the problem worse. Children spend hours on phones, tablets and TV instead of playing outside. For instance, my nephew plays video games for about three hours every evening, so he rarely moves.

Thirdly, the family and social environment also play an important role. If parents eat unhealthily and do not exercise, their children usually copy them. A good example is a busy family that often orders takeaway food because nobody has time to cook.

Another important point is that a lack of sleep can lead to obesity. Children who stay up late often feel hungry and eat more snacks. For example, with my medical background, I know that poor sleep can increase appetite.

To sum up, childhood obesity is caused by unhealthy eating, little exercise, too much screen time, the family environment and poor sleep. Parents and schools should work together to solve this problem.
follow_ups: Parents can cook healthy meals at home and keep less junk food in the house. The main reason is that children usually eat what is available. For example, they can put fruit on the table instead of sweets. They should also limit screen time and take their children swimming at weekends.

Yes, I think schools should play a bigger role in promoting healthy eating. The main reason is that children eat lunch at school almost every day. For example, schools can serve more vegetables and stop selling soft drinks. They can also teach students about nutrition in class.

Childhood obesity can cause serious health problems later in life. The main reason is that overweight children often become overweight adults. For example, they are more likely to have diabetes, high blood pressure and heart disease. They may also have low confidence and feel stressed.

2.answer:
People have different opinions on whether friends buy similar things, such as phones or jackets, to show friendship or just to copy others. This essay will discuss both views, but I believe that it mainly comes from our natural habit of copying people around us.

On the one hand, some people believe that buying the same items is a way to show friendship and follow trends. This is because matching things make friends feel close and part of the same group. Many young people also see matching items as a fun trend on social media. For example, a group of university students may buy the same hoodie with their club's name on it. As a result, they feel proud and connected when they wear it together.

On the other hand, I agree with those who think that it reflects a natural human tendency to copy others. Firstly, people often trust the choices of those around them. The reason is that copying a friend feels safer than making a new decision alone. For instance, when my close friend bought a new phone and said its camera was great, I bought the same model a month later. Secondly, people want to be accepted by their group. This means that they may buy things without really needing them. A good example is a teenager who asks his parents for expensive sneakers because all his classmates have them. Therefore, this behaviour is less about friendship and more about human nature.

In conclusion, although buying the same items can show friendship, I believe that it mainly comes from our natural habit of copying others. People trust their friends' choices, and they want to belong to a group.

Today I would like to talk about the trend of eating out among young people today. In my opinion, eating out has become a normal part of young people's lives.

Firstly, eating out is very popular among young people today. Many of them eat out several times a week, especially at lunchtime. For example, most of my young colleagues buy lunch at restaurants near our university every day.

Secondly, there are several reasons why young people prefer eating out. They are busy with work or study, so they do not have time to cook. For instance, after a long day, it is much easier to order a bowl of noodles than to go to the market and cook.

Thirdly, young people use some criteria for choosing a good restaurant. They usually care about the taste, the price and how clean the place is. A good example is my group of friends. We always read online reviews and look at photos before we try a new place.

Another important point is that eating out too often can cause some problems. Restaurant food often has a lot of oil, salt and sugar, and it costs more than home-cooked meals. For example, a friend of mine ate out every day for a year. He gained weight and spent most of his salary on food.

To sum up, eating out is popular among young people because it is convenient, and they choose restaurants carefully. However, they should not eat out too often.
3.own_idea: Problems of eating out too often
follow_ups: Yes, I think young people nowadays eat out very often. The main reason is that they are busy and have more money than in the past. For example, many of my friends eat out several times a week, especially at lunchtime. Some of them even eat out every day.

Many young people enjoy eating out because it saves time. The main reason is that they are busy with work or study. For example, after a long day, they would rather meet friends at a restaurant than cook and wash the dishes. Also, many young people do not know how to cook well.

People should think about the quality of the food and the price. The main reason is that they want a good meal that fits their budget. For example, I always check if the restaurant is clean and read reviews online. The location and the service are also important.

2.answer:
When people look for a job, they think about many things, such as pay, colleagues and their own interests. Although some people believe that money matters most, I believe that job satisfaction is the most important factor.

Admittedly, some people argue that salary is the most important factor. This is because people need money to pay for housing, food and their children's education. Prices in big cities also keep going up every year. For example, a young worker in Ho Chi Minh City may choose a well-paid sales job to support his parents. As a result, a high salary can give people a more comfortable and secure life.

However, I firmly believe that job satisfaction matters more for two main reasons. Firstly, people who enjoy their work feel happier and healthier. The reason is that we spend about eight hours a day at work, so a boring job can make us stressed. For instance, a friend of mine left a well-paid bank job to become a teacher, and she is much happier now. Secondly, people who love their jobs usually work harder and improve faster. This means that they often get promoted and earn more money later. A good example is my own job as a researcher. I enjoy using AI to help doctors, so I want to learn something new every day. As a result, job satisfaction can lead to both happiness and success.

In conclusion, although a good salary is important, I believe that job satisfaction is the most important factor. It makes people happier, and it helps them develop in their careers. Therefore, young people should choose a job they love, not only a job that pays well.
