Today I would like to talk about the impact of technology on learning. In my opinion, technology is useful, but it also has some negative effects on students.

Firstly, many students show over-reliance on technology. They use phones and computers for everything, even for simple tasks. For example, some students cannot do easy maths without a calculator app.

Secondly, technology can lead to reduced critical thinking. When students can find answers online in seconds, they do not think deeply by themselves. For instance, many students copy answers from the internet or AI tools without checking them.

Thirdly, students often face information overload. There is too much information online, and much of it is not reliable. A good example is a student who searches for a health topic and finds hundreds of articles with different opinions, so he feels confused.

Another important point is that too much screen time can cause health problems. Students who study on screens for many hours may have eye problems and poor sleep. For example, many students get headaches and dry eyes after studying online all day.

To sum up, technology in learning can cause over-reliance, reduced critical thinking, information overload and health problems. Therefore, students should use it wisely.
follow_ups: No, I do not think technology will completely replace traditional teaching methods. The main reason is that students still need teachers to guide and encourage them. For example, a computer cannot notice when a student feels sad or confused. Technology can support teachers, but it cannot replace them.

People should set limits on their screen time. The main reason is that they need to practise thinking by themselves. For example, they can try to solve a problem on their own first before they search online. They should also read paper books more often.

Students need digital skills, such as searching for information quickly. They also need critical thinking skills to check if the information is true. For example, they should compare several reliable websites before they believe something. Good time management is also important, so they do not waste time online.

2.answer:
Today, many children spend several hours a day on phones, tablets and computers. Parents and teachers are worried because this habit can harm children's health, behaviour and school results. This essay will discuss the main causes of this problem and suggest some solutions.

There are two main causes of this problem. Firstly, many parents are very busy with work, so they give their children a phone to keep them quiet. For example, it is common to see young children watching cartoons on a phone during family meals. As a result, children get used to screens very early, and many of them have eye problems. Secondly, games and video apps are designed to be very attractive. This means that children find it hard to stop playing or watching. For instance, many apps play the next video automatically, so a child can watch for hours. Therefore, he may go to bed late and feel tired at school.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, parents should set clear rules about screen time and follow these rules themselves. For instance, children can use devices for only one hour a day after they finish their homework. Parents should also put away their own phones during meals. Secondly, schools and local governments should give children more interesting things to do offline. A good example is free football, music or art clubs after school. Thanks to this, children can make friends, stay active and spend less time in front of screens.

In conclusion, children use electronic devices too much mainly because their parents are busy and apps are very attractive. However, this problem can be reduced if parents set clear rules and schools offer more offline activities. With their help, children can grow up healthier and happier.

Today I would like to talk about the benefits of failure in personal growth. In my opinion, failure is not always bad, and it can help us in many ways.

Firstly, failure helps us learn valuable lessons from our mistakes. When we fail, we can see clearly what we did wrong. For example, I failed my first driving test because I was too nervous, so I practised more and passed the second time.

Secondly, failure helps us build resilience and character. Each time we fail and stand up again, we become stronger and more patient. For instance, many students who fail the university entrance exam study for one more year and become much more mature.

Thirdly, failure can be a motivation for future success. It pushes us to try harder next time. A good example is Thomas Edison, who failed many times before he made a working light bulb.

Another important point is that failure helps us understand other people better. When we have experienced failure, we know how others feel when they fail. Therefore, we can encourage them and give them useful advice.

To sum up, failure teaches us lessons, makes us stronger, motivates us and helps us understand others. We should not be afraid of failure, and we should learn from it.
follow_ups: Yes, I think schools should teach students how to handle failure. Many students feel very sad and lose confidence when they fail an exam. For example, teachers can share stories of people who failed and then succeeded. This helps students learn to try again.

People can stay motivated by setting small goals after a failure. Each small success makes them feel more confident. For instance, a person who failed a job interview can practise with a friend every week. They can also talk to their family for support.

No, failure is not always a bad thing. It can teach us important lessons and make us stronger. For example, my first research project failed, but I learnt how to plan my work better. However, failure is bad if we give up after it.

2.answer:
In recent years, more and more young people have started to visit old temples, museums and ancient towns. Many of them even travel far to see these places during their holidays. This essay will discuss the main causes of this trend and its effects.

There are two main causes of this trend. Firstly, social media makes historical sites look attractive and exciting. Young people love to take beautiful photos and share them online. For example, many students visit Hoi An Ancient Town or Hue Imperial City in ao dai and post their photos on TikTok. Secondly, many historical sites have become more modern and interesting. This is because museums now use light shows, screens and night tours to attract visitors. For instance, the night tour at Hoa Lo Prison in Hanoi is very popular with young people.

This trend has two important effects. The first effect is that young people understand their country's history better. A good example is a student who visits the Cu Chi Tunnels and learns how hard life was during the war. Thanks to this, young people feel prouder of their country. Another effect is that local communities can earn more money. Visitors spend money on tickets, food, hotels and souvenirs, so many new jobs are created. For example, in Hoi An, many local families run small restaurants and gift shops for tourists. As a result, local governments have more money to repair and protect old buildings.

In conclusion, more young people visit historical sites mainly because of social media and more modern museums. This trend helps them understand their history better, and it also brings money to local communities.

Today I would like to talk about the disadvantages of doing exercise. In my opinion, exercise is good for us, but it also has some drawbacks.

Firstly, exercise can be a waste of time for busy people. Going to the gym or a pool often takes one or two hours, including travel time. For example, I need about an hour and a half to swim, shower and go home on a weekend morning.

Secondly, doing exercise can be a waste of money. Gym memberships, sports clothes and equipment are quite expensive. For instance, a good pair of running shoes can cost more than two million dong.

Thirdly, there is a risk of getting injuries. If people do not warm up or they train too hard, they can hurt their muscles or joints. A good example is my colleague, who hurt his knee while playing football last month.

Another important point is that exercise can make people feel tired and sore. After a hard workout, our muscles may hurt for a few days. For example, after my first gym class, I could hardly walk up the stairs the next day.

To sum up, exercise can waste our time and money, cause injuries and make us tired. However, if we exercise wisely, its benefits are still much bigger.
follow_ups: People can avoid getting injured by warming up before exercising and cooling down afterwards. The main reason is that warm muscles are less likely to get hurt. For example, I always stretch for five minutes before swimming. People should also start slowly and stop if they feel pain.

Yes, I think the benefits of exercise outweigh the disadvantages. The main reason is that exercise helps us prevent many diseases, such as heart disease and diabetes. For example, my father walks every morning, and his blood pressure is much better now. The disadvantages are small if we exercise carefully.

I would tell them to do short exercises at home. The main reason is that they do not need to travel or pay for a gym. For example, they can do ten minutes of push-ups or skipping before work. They can also walk or cycle to work and take the stairs.

2.answer:
Nowadays, children in many countries start learning a second language at primary school, and this subject is often required. Although some people think this time is better spent on other subjects, I believe that every student should study a foreign language.

Admittedly, some people argue that these lessons take too much time away from other subjects. This is because the school timetable is already very busy with maths, science and literature. In addition, some young children find a new language very difficult. For example, a primary student who studies English four hours a week has less time for reading or playing sports with friends. As a result, some children feel tired and stressed, and they may lose interest in learning.

However, I firmly believe that foreign languages should be a compulsory subject for two main reasons. Firstly, a foreign language opens many doors in the future. Most good jobs today ask for English skills, especially in international companies. For instance, in my research team, we read and write medical papers in English every day. Secondly, young children learn languages more easily than adults. This means that starting early helps them speak more naturally and with better pronunciation. A good example is my niece, who started English at six and can now talk confidently with foreign tourists. Therefore, compulsory language lessons give every child the same chance to succeed.

In conclusion, although language lessons may take time from other subjects, I believe that they should be compulsory. They open future opportunities, and children learn languages best when they are young. Schools should also make these lessons fun so that children do not feel stressed.

Today I would like to talk about the benefits of travelling in a group. In my opinion, group travel is cheaper, safer and more fun than travelling alone.

Firstly, travelling in a group helps us save money. We can share the cost of hotel rooms, taxis and food. For example, when I went to Da Lat with three friends, we rented one big room and paid much less than staying alone.

Secondly, group travel gives us increased safety. In a new place, it is easy to get lost or meet dishonest people. For instance, if someone in the group gets sick, the others can take him to a hospital quickly.

Thirdly, we can share experiences with others. Beautiful moments become more special when we enjoy them together. A good example is watching the sunrise on a mountain with friends and then talking about it for years.

Another important point is that travelling in a group helps us make new friends. When we join a tour, we often meet people from different places. For example, on a tour to Phu Quoc, I met a nurse from Hanoi, and we still keep in touch.

To sum up, travelling in a group helps us save money, stay safe, share experiences and make new friends. That is why I often travel with other people.
follow_ups: I prefer travelling in a group. The main reason is that it is safer and more fun, and I can share the cost with my friends. For example, my colleagues and I take a trip together every summer. However, sometimes I travel alone when I need some quiet time.

The biggest challenge is that people in a group have different opinions. The main reason is that everyone has different interests. For example, some people want to go shopping, but others want to visit museums. Also, the group often moves slowly because we have to wait for each other.

Group travel helps friends spend a lot of time talking and helping each other. The main reason is that we face small problems together on a trip. For example, when my friends and I got lost in Da Lat, we found the way together. After that trip, we became much closer.

Dear Bill,

Thank you for your email. I am happy to answer your questions about Ho Chi Minh City, where I live.

Regarding the highlights, the city is famous for its street food and lively nightlife. Visitors can try cheap and tasty dishes such as pho, banh mi and broken rice. They can also visit famous places like Ben Thanh Market and the Central Post Office. At night, Nguyen Hue Walking Street is full of music.

As for wrong information, many people believe that the city is only a busy business centre with no history. This is not true because it is more than 300 years old. It has many old pagodas and French buildings, such as Notre-Dame Cathedral.

About your question on other things, you should mention the weather and the traffic. The best time to visit is from December to April because it rarely rains. Also, there are millions of motorbikes, so tourists should cross the street carefully.

I hope this information is useful. Please send me your article when it is finished.

Best wishes,
Minh

2.answer:
Nowadays, many people often forget names, dates or important tasks. Scientists say that good daily habits can keep our brains sharp, but many people do not know this. This essay will discuss the main problems that lead to poor memory and suggest some solutions.

There are two main problems that lead to poor memory. Firstly, many people do not get enough sleep because they work late or use their phones in bed. This is a problem because our brain needs sleep to store new information. For example, a student who stays up late before an exam often forgets what he has studied and gets a low mark. Secondly, many people rarely exercise and depend too much on their phones. This means that their brains are not active enough. For instance, many office workers sit all day and save every phone number on their phones. As a result, they may forget meetings or important tasks at work.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, individuals should build healthy sleep habits and stop using phones one hour before bed. For instance, adults can try to sleep seven to eight hours every night. Employers should also avoid sending work messages late in the evening. Secondly, people should exercise regularly and train their brains every day. A good example is walking for thirty minutes after work and then reading a book or learning a new language. Thanks to this, their bodies stay healthy and their minds stay active.

In conclusion, poor memory is mainly caused by a lack of sleep and an inactive lifestyle. However, this problem can be reduced if people sleep better and keep both their bodies and minds active. With these simple habits, people of all ages can have a good memory.

Today I would like to talk about the benefits of participating in extracurricular activities. In my opinion, these activities are very useful for students.

Firstly, students can learn more skills outside the classroom. These are skills that they cannot learn from textbooks, such as teamwork and leadership. For example, when I joined the English club at university, I learnt how to organise events and speak in public.

Secondly, these activities help students balance academic and personal life. After many hours of studying, students need time to relax and do what they love. For instance, playing music or drawing for an hour can reduce stress before exams.

Thirdly, extracurricular activities help students build social relationships. They can meet people from different classes who share the same interests. A good example is my best friend, Lan. We met at a volunteer club ten years ago, and we are still close today.

Another important point is that these activities improve students' physical health. Many students sit at their desks all day, so they need to move more. For example, joining a football or swimming club keeps them fit and strong.

To sum up, extracurricular activities help students learn skills, balance their lives, make friends and stay healthy. Every student should try at least one activity.
follow_ups: I think sports clubs are the most popular among students, especially football and badminton. The main reason is that they are fun and help students stay fit. For example, at my university, the football club has the most members. Music clubs and English clubs are also very popular.

No, I do not think they should be compulsory at school. The main reason is that students have different interests and different amounts of free time. For example, some students must help their families after school. However, schools should encourage every student to try at least one activity.

Students should make a weekly timetable for both studying and activities. The main reason is that a clear plan helps them manage their time. For example, they can study every evening and join their club only on Saturday mornings. They should also choose one or two activities, not too many.

2.answer:
Nowadays, many countries are building solar farms and wind farms to replace coal and oil. Governments and companies are spending large amounts of money on these clean technologies to protect the planet. This essay will discuss both their advantages and disadvantages.

On the one hand, green energy has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that wind and solar power depend heavily on the weather. This is because solar panels cannot work at night, and wind turbines stop when the wind is weak. For example, a city that uses only solar power may not have enough electricity on cloudy days. As a result, countries still need expensive batteries or old coal power plants as a backup.

On the other hand, green energy brings two important benefits. Firstly, it is much cleaner than coal and oil. The reason is that solar panels and wind turbines do not produce smoke or harmful gases. For instance, people who live in cities with fewer coal power plants usually have fewer breathing problems. Secondly, sunlight and wind will never run out. This means that countries can produce their own energy and buy less fuel from abroad. A good example is Ninh Thuan in Vietnam, where many solar farms have been built because of its strong sunshine. Thanks to this, local people have more jobs, and the country saves money on imported fuel.

In conclusion, green energy has both advantages and disadvantages. Although it depends on the weather and needs costly backup systems, it is clean and will never run out. Therefore, governments and businesses should keep investing in better batteries to make it more reliable.

Today I would like to talk about the qualities that a good teacher should have. In my opinion, a good teacher needs more than just a degree.

Firstly, a good teacher should show creativity in teaching methods. Creative lessons make students interested, so they pay more attention. For example, my English teacher in high school used songs and games, and nobody felt sleepy in her class.

Secondly, a good teacher needs patience with students. Some students learn slowly, and they need more time to understand a lesson. For instance, a patient maths teacher will explain a difficult problem again instead of getting angry.

Thirdly, a good teacher must have extensive knowledge of the subject. Students often ask difficult questions, and the teacher should answer them correctly. A good example is my professor at medical school, who could answer almost every question about the human body.

Another important point is that a good teacher should have good communication skills. Even a very smart teacher cannot help students if he or she explains things badly. For example, a teacher who speaks clearly and listens to students can build a friendly classroom.

To sum up, a good teacher should be creative, patient, knowledgeable and good at communication. These qualities help students learn better and enjoy school.
follow_ups: I think patience is the most important quality for a teacher. The main reason is that without patience, a teacher cannot help weak students. For example, a patient teacher will explain a lesson many times until everyone understands. This makes students feel safe and confident in class.

A teacher's creativity makes lessons fun, so students pay more attention. The main reason is that students remember things better when they enjoy them. For example, when my teacher used role-plays in English class, I remembered new words much longer. Creative teachers also help students become creative themselves.

Yes, I think teachers today need some different qualities. The main reason is that students now learn with computers and the internet. For example, teachers need good technology skills to use online tools in class. They also need to teach students how to check information online.

2.essay_type: Opinion – agree or disagree (nêu quan điểm đồng ý / không đồng ý)
2.answer:
Fast food is now very popular, especially among young people, but it can cause health problems such as obesity. Some young people even eat it several times a week. Although some people believe that it should be banned completely, I disagree with this idea.

Admittedly, some people argue that a ban would make people healthier. This is because fast food often contains a lot of fat, salt and sugar. For example, a meal with fried chicken, chips and a soft drink can have more calories than a person needs in a whole day. As a result, people who eat fast food too often may become overweight and get diseases such as diabetes.

However, I firmly believe that fast food should not be banned for two main reasons. Firstly, a ban would take away people's freedom of choice. Adults should be able to decide what they eat, and eating a burger once a month is not harmful. It is a small treat, not a daily habit. For instance, my colleagues and I sometimes order pizza to celebrate a successful project. Secondly, fast food is very convenient for busy people. Many workers only have a short lunch break, so they need quick meals. A good example is a nurse at a busy hospital who often has only fifteen minutes to eat. Therefore, it is better to teach people to eat fast food in moderation than to ban it.

In conclusion, although fast food can cause health problems, I believe that it should not be banned because people need freedom of choice and quick meals. Instead, schools and parents should teach children how to eat healthily.

Another reason is that traditional costumes help students feel proud of our culture. In other words, they can learn to love Vietnamese traditions in a fun way. For instance, many young people rarely wear Ao Dai now. This event is a good chance for them to try it and take beautiful photos.

There are also some reasons why I do not choose the other two options. Regarding the traditional school uniform, I do not think it is the best choice because students wear it every day, so it is not special. As for casual clothes of their own choice, I do not think it is the best option either because some clothes may be too informal for a school event.

To sum up, out of these three options, I believe traditional costumes are the best choice because they are beautiful, meaningful and suitable for a holiday.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of protecting the environment. In my opinion, a clean environment is good for everyone.

Firstly, protecting the environment leads to improved public health. When the air and water are clean, people have fewer diseases. For example, with my medical background, I know that clean air can reduce asthma and lung disease.

Secondly, there are many economic benefits. A clean environment attracts tourists, so local people can earn more money. For instance, beautiful places like Ha Long Bay and Phu Quoc attract many tourists, so local hotels and restaurants do well.

Thirdly, protecting the environment means the preservation of natural resources for future generations. If we use up all the forests and clean water now, our children will have nothing left. A good example is the forests in the Central Highlands, which have become much smaller in the last thirty years.

Another important point is that protecting the environment helps protect wildlife. Many animals are losing their homes because of pollution and deforestation. For example, sea turtles often die because they eat plastic bags in the ocean.

To sum up, protecting the environment is good for our health, our economy, our children and wildlife. Everyone should do something small to help.
follow_ups: Individuals can do many small things to help. The easiest way is to change our daily habits. For example, we can use less plastic, save electricity and recycle our rubbish. We can also take buses instead of using private cars.

No, I do not think governments are doing enough. Many rivers and big cities are still very polluted. For instance, the air in Hanoi is often unhealthy in winter. Governments should make stricter laws and punish companies that pollute the environment.

Environmental protection helps the economy in several ways. Firstly, it creates new jobs in areas such as recycling and solar energy. For example, many young engineers now work for solar companies in Ninh Thuan. In addition, healthy workers can work better, so the economy grows.

2.answer:
Over the last ten years, social media has spread quickly and is now used by people of every age. It has changed how we talk to each other, in both good and bad ways. This essay will discuss the main effects of this change.

To begin with, social media helps individuals communicate in two positive ways. Firstly, people can contact each other quickly and cheaply, wherever they are. This is because apps like Zalo and Messenger allow free messages and video calls. For example, a worker in Japan can see and talk to his children in Vietnam every evening. Secondly, social media makes it easier to share news with many people at once. For instance, a teacher can post a message in a class group, and all the parents receive it immediately. As a result, communication in families, schools and workplaces becomes much faster.

In addition, social media also has two negative effects on communication habits. One important point is that people talk face to face less often. The reason is that many prefer chatting on their phones, even when they sit together. A good example is a group of friends in a coffee shop who look at their screens instead of talking. Another point is that online messages are often short and careless. People use a lot of emojis and slang, so misunderstandings happen easily. For example, a short reply like "OK" can sound cold or angry to the reader. Therefore, people may slowly lose the skill of expressing their feelings clearly.

In conclusion, the growth of social media affects communication habits in many ways. It makes contact faster and easier, but it also reduces face-to-face talk and leads to careless messages. Therefore, people should use it wisely.

In this situation, among the three options, I think encouraging children to take part in alternative activities is the best choice. I choose it for two main reasons.

The first reason is that this option solves the real problem. By that, I mean many children play video games because they are bored and have nothing better to do. For example, if a boy joins a football club after school, he will have less free time and less interest in games.

Another reason is that sports and reading are good for children's health and development. In other words, children not only play fewer games but also learn new skills. For instance, my nephew started swimming lessons last summer, and now he is stronger and has new friends at the pool.

There are also some reasons why I do not choose the other two options. Regarding setting strict daily time limits, I do not think it is the best choice because children often argue with their parents about every extra minute. They may also play secretly when their parents are at work. As for completely banning video games at home, I do not think it is the best option either because it is too strict. Children can still play at their friends' houses, and some games are actually educational.

To sum up, out of these three options, I believe encouraging alternative activities is the best choice because it is positive, healthy and effective.

Today I would like to talk about how I would introduce my city, Ho Chi Minh City, to a club. In my opinion, I would choose a well-known place because visitors can enjoy it at any time of the year.

Firstly, famous landmarks and attractions show the history and character of a city. They are often the first things that tourists want to see. For example, the Independence Palace and Ben Thanh Market tell visitors a lot about the past and daily life of Saigon.

Secondly, local events and festivals are also very attractive. They show the energy and traditions of local people. For instance, the Nguyen Hue Flower Street during Tet is full of colourful flowers, and thousands of people come to take photos.

Thirdly, cultural and culinary experiences help visitors understand the city deeply. Food is a part of our culture, and Ho Chi Minh City has many cheap and delicious dishes. A good example is banh mi, which many foreign tourists love to try at street stalls.

Another important point is that the modern side of the city is also interesting. There are many tall buildings, rooftop coffee shops and shopping centres. For example, visitors can enjoy a view of the whole city from the top of Landmark 81.

To sum up, landmarks, festivals, food and modern life all make my city special. However, I would choose a well-known place because it is always open to visitors.

For example, tourists can visit Ha Long Bay in any season. However, a big event like the Da Nang fireworks festival can attract many people quickly.

Cities can promote their culture better by using social media. The main reason is that most young tourists plan their trips online. For example, the city can post short videos about local food and traditional music on TikTok. It can also offer free walking tours in English for foreign visitors.

Yes, I think local festivals can really help boost tourism in my city. The main reason is that festivals give visitors a special reason to come at a certain time. For example, during Tet, many tourists visit Ho Chi Minh City to see the Flower Street. As a result, hotels and restaurants earn more money.

2.answer:
Nowadays, many people have a large number of friends on social media. They often spend their free time chatting with these online friends instead of meeting their real, close friends. This essay will discuss both the advantages and disadvantages of this trend.

On the one hand, having lots of online friends has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that people may spend less time with their real friends and family. This is because chatting online is easy and takes up much of their free time. For example, a young office worker may reply to dozens of messages every evening but rarely meet his best friend for coffee. As a result, his close relationships can become weak, and he may feel lonely even with hundreds of online contacts.

On the other hand, having many online friends brings two important benefits. Firstly, it helps people keep in touch with others easily and cheaply. Distance is no longer a problem when friends can chat and make video calls for free. For instance, I can still talk to my old classmates who now live in Australia and Japan every week. Secondly, online friends can bring useful information and opportunities. The reason is that a large network includes people from many different jobs and places. A good example is a student who finds a part-time job through a post shared by an online friend. Thanks to this, people can learn new things and develop their careers.

In conclusion, having lots of online friends has both advantages and disadvantages. It helps people stay in touch and find opportunities, but it may also take time away from their close friends. Therefore, people should balance their online and offline relationships.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about why misbehaviour is becoming more common in some schools. In my opinion, there are several causes, and schools, families and society all play a part.

Firstly, school discipline is sometimes not strong enough. When rules are not clear or teachers do not apply them fairly, students think they can break them easily. For example, if a student uses his phone in class and nobody says anything, other students will copy him.

Secondly, family background has a big influence on children's behaviour. Children whose parents argue a lot or are always busy often lack care and guidance. For instance, a child whose parents work late every night may join a bad group to get attention.

Thirdly, the internet has a strong effect on students. Many videos and games show violence or rude language as something cool. A good example is the trend of filming fights at school and posting them on TikTok.

Another important point is that peer pressure can push students to misbehave. Teenagers want to be accepted by their friends, so they may do things they know are wrong. For example, a quiet boy may start skipping classes because his friends call him boring.

To sum up, weak school discipline, family problems, the internet and peer pressure are the main causes of misbehaviour in schools.
follow_ups: There are many kinds of misbehaviour among children. The common ones are talking in class, being late and not doing homework. More serious kinds are bullying, cheating in exams and fighting. For example, some students make fun of a classmate online, and this can hurt him deeply.

I think parents are most responsible for preventing student misbehaviour. The main reason is that children learn their values and habits at home first. For example, children whose parents talk to them every day usually behave better at school. However, teachers also need to work closely with parents.

Schools can reduce misbehaviour by setting clear rules and applying them fairly. The main reason is that students behave better when they know the results of their actions. For example, schools can hold regular meetings with parents and invite counsellors to talk with students. More clubs and sports can also keep students busy.

2.answer:
In recent years, many countries have spent a lot of money on clean power from the sun, wind and water. Although some people believe that this trend has serious problems, I think it is a positive change.

Admittedly, some people argue that alternative energy has some drawbacks. This is because it can be expensive and may harm nature in some cases. For example, large hydroelectric dams in Vietnam have flooded forests and forced some villages to move. As a result, local people may lose their land, and wild animals may lose their homes.

However, I firmly believe that the growing use of alternative energy is a positive development for two main reasons. Firstly, it makes the air cleaner and protects people's health. Solar and wind power do not produce smoke like coal power plants. For instance, many people in big cities like Hanoi suffer from asthma and lung disease because of polluted air. With more clean energy, the number of these patients can go down. Secondly, alternative energy helps countries become more independent and creates jobs. This means that countries do not need to buy so much coal and oil from abroad, because sunlight and wind are free. A good example is Ninh Thuan, where many solar and wind farms have created new jobs for local people. Therefore, alternative energy is good for both the environment and the economy.

In conclusion, although alternative energy has some drawbacks, I believe that its growing use is a positive development because it protects our health and supports the economy. Governments should continue to invest in it, but they should also plan carefully to protect nature.

Today I would like to talk about effective ways to stay healthy in daily life. In my opinion, good health comes from simple habits that we follow every day.

Firstly, regular exercise is very important. It makes our heart and muscles stronger and helps us keep a healthy weight. For example, I go swimming every weekend, and I rarely get sick.

Secondly, eating healthy food gives our body the energy it needs. We should eat more vegetables, fruit and fish, and less fried or sweet food. For instance, my family usually has a simple dinner with rice, vegetable soup and fish.

Thirdly, managing stress effectively helps both our mind and our body. Too much stress can cause headaches and poor sleep. A good example is my habit of reading a book or meeting friends at a coffee shop after a busy week.

Another important point is that people should have regular health check-ups. Many serious diseases have no signs at first, so doctors need to find them early. For example, a simple blood test once a year can show high blood sugar before it becomes diabetes.

To sum up, regular exercise, healthy food, low stress and regular check-ups can help us stay healthy every day.
follow_ups: I think swimming is one of the most effective types of exercise for staying healthy. The main reason is that it works the whole body but is gentle on the joints. For example, my grandfather has knee pain, but he can still swim twice a week. Walking and cycling are also good choices.

Stress can affect a person's health in many ways. The main reason is that the body stays tense for a long time. For example, stressed people often have headaches, stomach problems and trouble sleeping. Over time, stress can also lead to high blood pressure and heart disease.

No, I do not think most young people pay enough attention to their health. The main reason is that they are busy and often feel strong. For example, many students stay up late, skip breakfast and drink milk tea every day. However, some young people now go to the gym regularly.

2.answer:
Nowadays, in many homes, mothers still do most of the cooking, cleaning and childcare. However, more and more families now divide this work among everyone in the house. This essay will discuss the main benefits of this change.

To begin with, sharing household chores helps individual family members in two ways. Firstly, mothers feel less pressure and have more free time. When the work is shared, they are less tired and can focus on their jobs or their health. For example, a working mother can go to a yoga class in the evening while her husband washes the dishes. Secondly, children learn useful life skills and responsibility. This means that they can look after themselves when they grow up. For instance, a teenager who cooks dinner twice a week will find it easier to live alone at university. As a result, children become more independent.

In addition, sharing household chores also helps the family and society. One important point is that family members become closer. Working together gives them more time to talk and laugh. A good example is a family that cleans the house together every Sunday morning and then has lunch together. Another point is that children learn that men and women should share responsibilities equally. For example, a boy who often sees his father cooking and cleaning will understand that housework is not only for women. Thanks to this, he will share the housework fairly with his own wife in the future.

In conclusion, sharing household chores benefits both individuals and society in many ways. It reduces the pressure on mothers, teaches children life skills, brings families closer and supports equality between men and women.

Today I would like to talk about effective solutions to reduce obesity in modern society. In my opinion, small changes in our daily habits can make a big difference.

Firstly, people should eat less fast food. Fast food often has a lot of fat, sugar and salt, so it gives us too many calories. For example, my younger brother gained a lot of weight when he ate burgers for lunch almost every day.

Secondly, exercising regularly helps people burn calories and stay fit. Even thirty minutes of walking a day is good for the heart. For instance, I go swimming every weekend, and it helps me keep a healthy weight.

Thirdly, cooking meals at home is a healthy habit. When we cook, we can choose fresh ingredients and use less oil and sugar. A good example is my family, who usually cook rice, vegetables and fish for dinner instead of ordering food online.

Another important point is that people should get enough sleep. When we sleep too little, we feel hungry more often and want sweet food. For example, many office workers who stay up late often eat snacks at midnight.

To sum up, eating less fast food, exercising regularly, cooking at home and sleeping well can all help to reduce obesity.
follow_ups: In Vietnam, fried chicken, burgers and pizza are very popular, especially among young people. The main reason is that big chains such as KFC and Lotteria have shops everywhere. Vietnamese fast food like banh mi is also popular. For example, many students buy a banh mi on their way to school.

Many people choose fast food because it is quick and convenient. The main reason is that they are very busy with work or study. For example, office workers often have only a short lunch break, so they order fast food through apps. Fast food is also tasty and quite cheap.

Apart from obesity, fast food can cause many other health problems. The main reason is that it contains too much salt, sugar and unhealthy fat. For example, eating it too often can lead to high blood pressure, diabetes and heart disease. It can also cause stomach problems and bad skin.

2.answer:
People have different opinions on whether buying the same things as our friends is just normal human nature. This essay will discuss both views, but I believe that this habit is mainly caused by social pressure and advertising.

On the one hand, some people believe that copying others is a normal part of being human. This is because people live in groups and often trust the experience of those around them. For example, if a close friend is happy with her new phone, we may buy the same model without reading many reviews. As a result, we save time and avoid the risk of making a bad choice.

On the other hand, I agree with those who think that this habit is mostly shaped by advertising and social pressure. Firstly, companies and influencers deliberately encourage people to copy each other. They pay famous people to show their products online so that fans want to own the same things. For instance, many young people rush to buy a certain lipstick after a famous TikToker uses it in a short video. Secondly, many people buy things because they want to fit in with their group. The reason is that they are afraid of looking different or old-fashioned. A good example is a student who asks his parents for an expensive smartphone because all his classmates have one. Therefore, people often spend money on things they do not really need.

In conclusion, although copying others may seem natural, I believe that it is mainly caused by advertising and the wish to fit in. People should think carefully about their real needs before they buy something new.

Today I would like to talk about the benefits of training programs for employees. In my opinion, training is good for both workers and companies.

Firstly, training programs help employees improve their job performance and skills. Workers learn new methods and tools that they can use every day. For example, after a short course on data analysis, my colleagues could finish their research reports much faster.

Secondly, training boosts employee confidence and motivation. When people know how to do their jobs well, they feel less stressed and more willing to try new tasks. For instance, a young nurse who attends a first-aid workshop will feel more confident in emergencies.

Thirdly, training increases company productivity and growth. Skilled workers make fewer mistakes and produce better results. A good example is a hospital that trains its staff to use new software, so patients wait less and more people can be served.

Another important point is that training helps companies keep good employees. Workers feel that the company cares about their future, so they want to stay longer. For example, many of my friends chose their current jobs because the companies offered free English and computer courses.

To sum up, training programs improve skills, confidence and productivity, and they also help companies keep their best people.
follow_ups: I think a good trainer and practical content make a training session successful. The main reason is that people learn best when they can use the knowledge right away. For example, a workshop with real tasks and group discussions is more useful than a long lecture. The session should also be short and well-organised.

In my area, English and computer skills workshops are very popular. The main reason is that these skills help people find better jobs. For example, many young people in Ho Chi Minh City take weekend courses on Excel or IELTS. Workshops on public speaking and online business are also becoming popular.

Yes, I think all companies should invest in employee training. The main reason is that technology and customer needs change very quickly. For example, many offices now use AI tools, so staff need training to use them well. Even small companies can offer short and cheap online courses.

2.answer:
Today, arguments between parents and teenagers happen in many homes. If families ignore these arguments, their relationships can become weak and cold. This essay will discuss the main causes of this issue and suggest some solutions.

There are two main causes of these conflicts. Firstly, parents and teenagers grow up in very different times, so they have different values. Parents often want their children to study hard, while teenagers want more freedom. For example, a mother may think that online games are a waste of time, but her son sees them as a way to make friends. As a result, they argue often, and the teenager may feel that nobody understands him. Secondly, family members do not talk to each other enough. This is because parents are busy with work and teenagers spend a lot of time on their phones. For instance, many families eat dinner together, but everyone looks at a screen. Therefore, small problems are not discussed, and teenagers start to hide things from their parents.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, parents should listen to their children and respect their opinions. This means that they should explain their rules instead of just giving orders. For instance, parents and their son can agree on one hour of gaming after he finishes his homework. Secondly, families should spend regular time talking without phones. A good example is a weekly family dinner where nobody uses a phone and everyone shares their news. Thanks to this, parents and teenagers can understand each other better and solve problems early.

In conclusion, family conflicts are mainly caused by different values and poor communication, but they can be reduced if parents listen and families talk more. With patience from both sides, homes can become happier and more peaceful.

Today I would like to talk about effective ways to reduce crime rates in society. In my opinion, we need to combine several methods to make our cities safer.

Firstly, the government should install security cameras in public areas. Criminals are less likely to break the law when they know someone is watching. For example, many streets in Ho Chi Minh City now have cameras, and the police use them to find motorbike thieves quickly.

Secondly, building more prisons and giving stricter punishment can stop some people from committing crimes. When the punishment is serious, people think carefully before they do something wrong. For instance, heavy fines for drunk driving have made many drivers in Vietnam more careful.

Thirdly, improving education and awareness is the long-term solution. When young people understand the law and the harm of crime, they are less likely to become criminals. A good example is the talks about drugs and online scams that the police give at many high schools.

Another important point is that young people need jobs and useful activities. Some people commit crimes because they are poor or bored. For example, free job training courses can help young people earn money in an honest way.

To sum up, cameras, strict punishment, education and job opportunities can all help to reduce crime and make our society safer.

2.answer:
Nowadays, many museums hold exhibitions about the past, where people can see old objects and learn their stories. Although some people believe that these visits are boring and unnecessary, I agree that they are very useful for everyone.

Admittedly, some people argue that visiting exhibitions is a waste of time and money. This is because people can now find the same information on the internet for free. For example, a student can watch a video about Vietnamese history on YouTube at home. As a result, many young people think that exhibitions are old-fashioned and boring, so they rarely visit them.

However, I firmly believe that visiting historical exhibitions is beneficial for two main reasons. Firstly, they help visitors learn about history in a real and memorable way. Seeing real objects is much more interesting than reading a textbook, so the lessons stay in our minds longer. For instance, at the War Remnants Museum in Ho Chi Minh City, visitors can see old weapons and photos from the war. These things help them understand the cost of war and the value of peace. Secondly, exhibitions help people understand their culture and feel proud of it. The reason is that many exhibitions show traditional clothes, tools and customs. A good example is the Museum of Ethnology in Hanoi, where visitors can learn about the 54 ethnic groups of Vietnam. Therefore, young people become more interested in their own traditions.

In conclusion, although some people think exhibitions are boring, I believe that visiting them is beneficial because it makes history easier to remember and helps people understand their culture. Schools and families should visit them more often.

In this situation, among the three options, I think arranging outdoor team-building activities is the best choice. I choose it for two main reasons.

The first reason is that these activities improve skills and well-being at the same time. By that, I mean employees can practise teamwork and communication while they enjoy fresh air and exercise. For example, in a treasure hunt game, each team must plan together, share tasks and support each other.

Another reason is that outdoor activities help colleagues build closer relationships. In other words, people from different departments can get to know each other outside the office. For instance, after a team-building trip to Vung Tau, my colleagues and I started to have lunch together and help each other more at work.

There are also some reasons why I do not choose the other two options. Regarding organising skill-building workshops, I do not think it is the best choice because this option only focuses on skills, not on well-being. Employees may also feel tired if they have to sit in another long session after work. As for providing online learning courses, I do not think it is the best option either because employees already spend many hours in front of a computer. These courses also give them very little chance to talk with their colleagues.

To sum up, out of these three options, I believe arranging outdoor team-building activities is the best choice because it is healthy, fun and useful for teamwork.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about what companies should consider when hiring new employees. In my opinion, a good hiring decision depends on several important factors.

Firstly, companies should check qualifications and technical skills. A new employee needs the right knowledge to do the job well from the first day. For example, a hospital must hire nurses who have a nursing degree and a licence.

Secondly, soft skills and attitude are very important. Skills like communication and teamwork help people work well with others, and a good attitude means they are willing to learn. For instance, in my research team, a friendly and hard-working person is more useful than a clever person who never listens.

Thirdly, companies should think about cultural fit within the company. Every company has its own values and working style. A good example is a start-up where people work very fast, so a person who likes a slow pace may feel uncomfortable there.

Another important point is that companies should consider work experience. Experienced people can start working quickly and need less training. For example, a nurse with five years of experience can work in the emergency room after only one week.

To sum up, companies should consider qualifications, soft skills, cultural fit and experience before they choose a new employee.
follow_ups: I think good preparation and confidence make a candidate stand out. The main reason is that interviewers like people who know a lot about the company. For example, a candidate who can talk about the company's recent projects shows real interest. A friendly smile and clear answers also leave a good impression.

In my opinion, companies should prioritise potential for most junior positions. The main reason is that young people with potential learn fast and bring new ideas. For example, many fresh graduates in my team learnt to use AI tools in just a few months. However, for senior jobs, experience is more important.

The hiring process has changed a lot in recent years because of technology. Most companies now post jobs online and do the first interview on Zoom or Google Meet. For example, I had my last job interview online from home. Some big companies even use AI to read CVs and choose candidates.

1.answer:
Hi Mark,

Thank you for your email. I am really happy that you are coming to my hometown, Buon Ma Thuot, next month.

Regarding shopping, there are many good places here. In the city centre, there is a big shopping mall with clothes shops, a supermarket and a cinema. If you want something more local, you should visit the central market, where you can buy fresh fruit, souvenirs and the famous Dak Lak coffee.

As for the town itself, Buon Ma Thuot is the capital of Dak Lak province in the Central Highlands. About 400,000 people live here, so it is much less crowded than Ho Chi Minh City. The town is green and peaceful, and it is surrounded by coffee farms and waterfalls.

About my own experience, I lived here until I was eighteen, and I really loved it. People are friendly, and life is slow and relaxing. However, there is not much nightlife, so the evenings can be a bit quiet.

That's all for now. I can't wait to show you around!

Best wishes,
Minh

2.answer:
Nowadays, motorbikes are a common way to travel in many countries, especially in busy cities such as Ho Chi Minh City. Riding a motorbike is quick and easy, but many people worry about road safety and air pollution. This essay will discuss both its advantages and disadvantages.

On the one hand, riding motorbikes has one main advantage. The biggest benefit is that motorbikes are convenient and flexible for daily travel. This is because they are cheap to buy, use little fuel and can move easily through narrow streets. Parking is also easy, even in crowded city centres. For example, an office worker can ride through small alleys to avoid traffic jams and still reach work on time. As a result, motorbikes save people both time and money every day.

On the other hand, riding motorbikes brings two serious problems. Firstly, motorbikes are less safe than cars. Riders have no protection around them, so even a small accident at low speed can cause serious injuries. For instance, many patients in city hospitals are motorbike riders with head injuries after road accidents. As a result, riders and their families may suffer for a long time. Secondly, motorbikes cause air pollution and noise. This means that busy cities with millions of motorbikes often have dirty air and loud streets. A good example is Hanoi, where the air is often unhealthy during rush hour in winter. Therefore, more people may suffer from breathing problems.

In conclusion, riding motorbikes has both advantages and disadvantages. Motorbikes are cheap and convenient, but they are dangerous and cause pollution. Therefore, riders should always wear good helmets, and cities should improve public transport to reduce pollution.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of investing in art. In my opinion, art is not only beautiful but also a good investment for people and society.

Firstly, art has economic value and can bring long-term financial returns. The price of a good painting often goes up over time, especially when the artist becomes famous. For example, some paintings by famous Vietnamese artists now sell for much more money than they did many years ago.

Secondly, investing in art helps to preserve culture and history. Paintings, statues and traditional crafts show how people lived and thought in the past. For instance, Dong Ho folk paintings help young Vietnamese people learn about old village life.

Thirdly, buying art supports artists and creative industries. When people buy their work, artists can earn a living and continue to create. A good example is Hoi An, where many young local painters sell their work to tourists in small galleries.

Another important point is that art can improve our mental health. Looking at beautiful paintings makes people feel calm and happy. For example, many hospitals hang paintings on the walls to help patients relax.

To sum up, investing in art brings money, protects culture, supports artists and makes people happier.
follow_ups: I think most people prefer going to museums. The main reason is that buying real art is very expensive, while museum tickets are cheap. For example, students can visit the Fine Arts Museum in Ho Chi Minh City for a small fee. However, rich people often like to buy art for their homes.

Yes, I think they will change a lot in the next 30 years. The main reason is that technology is developing very fast. For example, many museums will use virtual reality, so people can visit them online from home. Artists may also use AI to create new kinds of art.

Yes, I think governments should spend more money supporting the arts. The main reason is that art protects our culture and attracts tourists. For example, a government can repair old theatres and give small grants to young artists. However, they should not cut money from health care or education.

2.answer:
Nowadays, public transport carries millions of people to work and school in big cities every day. It is a popular choice instead of cars and motorbikes, but it is not perfect. This essay will discuss both its advantages and disadvantages.

On the one hand, public transport has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that it is often crowded and not always on time. This is because there are not enough buses and trains during rush hour. Traffic jams also slow buses down. For example, many buses in Ho Chi Minh City are full at 7 a.m., so passengers have to stand for a long time. As a result, some people still prefer their own motorbikes because they want to be comfortable and arrive on time.

On the other hand, public transport brings two important benefits. Firstly, it helps to reduce traffic jams. One bus can carry about fifty people, while fifty motorbikes take up a lot of road space. For instance, many office workers now take the new metro line in Ho Chi Minh City instead of riding motorbikes. Secondly, public transport is better for the environment. This means that cities have less smoke and noise when fewer people use private vehicles. A good example is Singapore, where many people take the metro every day and the air is quite clean. Thanks to this, people in the city can live healthier lives.

In conclusion, public transport has both advantages and disadvantages. It can be crowded and late, but it reduces traffic jams and protects the environment. Therefore, cities should invest in more buses and metro lines to make the service better.

In this situation, among the three options, I think visiting a museum and relaxing in a park is the best choice. I choose it for two main reasons.

The first reason is that this plan is easy and cheap. By that, I mean there are many museums and parks in Ho Chi Minh City. We do not need to travel far or spend much money. For example, we can visit the War Remnants Museum in the morning and have a picnic in Tao Dan Park in the afternoon.

Another reason is that this activity is both interesting and relaxing. In other words, we can learn something new and still have time to rest and chat. For instance, after walking around the museum, we can sit under the trees, eat some snacks and talk about what we saw. Everyone in the group can enjoy it, even people who are not very fit.

There are also some reasons why I do not choose the other two options. Regarding going on a hiking adventure in the mountains, I do not think it is the best choice because it is tiring and the mountains are far from the city. As for spending the day relaxing at a spa, I do not think it is the best option either because it is quite expensive.

To sum up, out of these three options, I believe visiting a museum and relaxing in a park is the best choice because it is cheap, interesting and relaxing.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the positive effects of volunteering on young people's personal development. In my opinion, volunteering is one of the best ways for young people to grow up.

Firstly, there are many types of volunteer activities for young people. They can teach poor children, clean beaches, or help at hospitals and old people's homes. For example, during the Green Summer campaign, many students go to rural areas to build roads and teach children.

Secondly, volunteers gain many personal skills and grow as people. They learn to communicate, work in a team and solve problems in difficult situations. For instance, when I helped at a free health check-up event, I learnt to stay calm and talk kindly to elderly patients.

Thirdly, volunteering brings benefits for the community and society. Volunteers help people in need, and they also make society kinder. A good example is a group of students who collect old books and send them to schools in the mountains.

Another important point is that volunteering can help young people with their future careers. Employers like candidates who have volunteer experience. For example, a student who volunteers at a hospital may find it easier to get a job in healthcare later.

To sum up, volunteering offers many activities, builds personal skills, helps society and supports young people's careers.
3.own_idea: Helping young people with their future careers
follow_ups: I think young people should get involved because volunteering helps them grow. Firstly, they learn new skills and understand the difficulties of other people. For example, a student who teaches poor children can become more patient and grateful. It is also a good way to use free time.

Volunteers may have problems with time and money. The main reason is that many activities take place in remote areas, so the trips can be long and tiring. For example, a volunteer may have to travel for ten hours by bus to reach a mountain village. Some volunteers also feel sad when they see poverty.

No, I think schools should encourage volunteer work, but not require it. The main reason is that students may not enjoy it if they are forced to do it. For example, some students only volunteer to get a certificate. Instead, schools can offer many activities and give small rewards.

2.answer:
Today, many students carry a mobile phone to school, even in lower secondary schools. People have different opinions on whether this habit is useful or harmful. This essay will discuss both views, but I believe that phones should be allowed at school with clear rules.

On the one hand, some people believe that phones cause more problems than benefits at school. This is because students can easily get distracted by games, social media and messages, and teachers cannot check every screen. For example, a pupil may secretly watch TikTok videos under the desk during a maths lesson. As a result, he cannot follow the lesson, and his marks may go down. This is why many teachers want to ban phones in the classroom.

On the other hand, I agree with those who think that students should be allowed to bring phones. Firstly, phones help students stay in touch with their parents. Parents feel safer when they can call their children at any time during the day. For instance, a child can call home if the school bus is late or if he feels sick. Secondly, phones can be useful learning tools. This means that students can look up information and use learning apps in class. A good example is a teacher who asks students to use a dictionary app during an English lesson. Therefore, phones can support learning if schools have clear rules about when to use them.

In conclusion, although phones can distract students, I believe that they should be allowed at school because they keep children in touch with their parents and support learning. However, schools need clear rules so that students use phones properly.

Today I would like to talk about the importance of teamwork skills for students. In my opinion, students who can work well in a team will be more successful in the future.

Firstly, a leader plays a key role in guiding a team. A good leader sets clear goals and helps members when they have problems. For example, in my English class, our group leader gave each person one part of the presentation, so nobody felt confused.

Secondly, sharing and combining ideas leads to better results. One person may have a good idea, but a group can make it even better. For instance, when we planned a charity event at university, my friends added many creative ideas to my first plan.

Thirdly, teamwork brings benefits to studying and future careers. Students can learn from each other and finish big projects faster. A good example is my job now. My team includes doctors, engineers and data experts, and we learn a lot from each other.

Another important point is that teamwork improves communication skills. Students have to explain their ideas clearly and listen to others. For example, a shy student may become more confident after many group discussions.

To sum up, teamwork skills are important because of good leaders, shared ideas, future benefits and better communication.
follow_ups: A good team leader should be responsible and fair. The main reason is that members will only follow a leader they respect. For example, a good leader gives clear instructions and shares the work equally. Most importantly, he or she sets a good example for the team.

No, I do not think teamwork is always better. The main reason is that simple tasks are often faster when we work alone. For example, I can check a short document by myself in ten minutes. However, big projects usually need teamwork because one person cannot do everything.

Students can improve their teamwork skills by joining group projects, clubs and volunteer activities. The main reason is that they need real practice with other people. For example, playing team sports like football teaches them to support each other. They should also practise listening and sharing ideas.

Hi Lan,

Thank you for your email. It is great that you are organising our end-term party, and I am happy to help.

Regarding extra guests, I think each person can invite one friend, but not more. Our room at Hoa Sen Restaurant is quite small, and more guests will cost more money. Please ask everyone to send you their friend's name before Friday so that you can order enough food.

As for the activities, I think we should organise some games and a small competition, such as a quiz about our class. Games are fun, and even shy classmates can join in easily. We can also have some dancing at the end for people who enjoy it.

About the dress code, I do not think we should ask everyone to dress formally. Formal clothes are not comfortable for games, and some people do not have them. Instead, everyone can wear something blue to make our photos look nice.

That's all for now. See you at the party at 6 p.m. on Saturday!

Best wishes,
Minh

2.answer:
In recent years, more and more young people have started to spend their weekends at museums, ancient towns and other historic places. Experts want to know why this is happening. This essay will discuss the main causes of this trend and its effects.

There are two main causes of this new interest. Firstly, social media encourages young people to visit old places. Many of them want to take beautiful photos and share them online. For example, Hoi An Ancient Town is full of young visitors who post pictures on TikTok and Instagram every day. Secondly, many museums have become more modern and interesting. This means that visitors can learn history in a fun and active way. For instance, some museums now use VR glasses and touch screens, so young people can see how people lived hundreds of years ago.

This trend has two important effects. The first effect is that young people understand their history and culture better. They learn about the past by seeing real objects, not only by reading textbooks. A good example is a student who visits the Imperial City in Hue and becomes interested in the Nguyen Dynasty. Another effect is that historical sites earn more money from tourism. Local governments can use this money to repair old buildings and protect them. As a result, local people also have more jobs in restaurants, hotels and souvenir shops.

In conclusion, this trend is mainly caused by social media and more modern museums. It helps young people learn about their history, and it brings money to protect old places and create local jobs. Therefore, it is a good sign for society.

In this situation, among the three options, I think going to the zoo is the best choice for my best friend's child. I choose it for two main reasons.

The first reason is that most children love animals. By that, I mean they become very excited when they see animals in real life, not just in books or on TV. For example, at Saigon Zoo, my friend's six-year-old daughter can see elephants, tigers, monkeys and giraffes in one day.

Another reason is that the zoo is a great place to learn. In other words, the child can have fun and learn new things at the same time. For instance, there is a sign with information about every animal, so I can read it and tell her some interesting facts. The zoo also has big gardens and a playground where she can run around.

There are also some reasons why I do not choose the other two options. Regarding going to an aquarium, I do not think it is the best choice because the nearest big aquarium is far from my home. We would spend too much time travelling. As for going to the park, I do not think it is the best option either because she often plays in the park, so it is not special.

To sum up, out of these three options, I believe going to the zoo is the best choice because it is fun, educational and memorable.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of young people keeping pets. In my opinion, a pet can make a young person's life happier and healthier.

Firstly, pets provide emotional support. When young people feel stressed or sad, a pet can make them feel calm. For example, my younger cousin always plays with her cat after a difficult day at school, and she feels much better.

Secondly, pets encourage a healthier daily routine. Dog owners have to wake up early and take their dogs outside every day. For instance, my friend Nam walks his dog in the park every morning, so he gets more exercise than before.

Thirdly, pets give companionship and reduce feelings of loneliness. Many young people live alone in a big city, far from their families. A good example is a student from Da Nang who studies in Ho Chi Minh City and keeps a small cat in her room. She says she never feels alone now.

Another important point is that keeping a pet teaches young people responsibility. They must feed, clean and take care of an animal every day. For example, a teenager who looks after a dog learns to plan his time and keep his promises.

To sum up, pets bring emotional support, a healthier routine, companionship and a sense of responsibility to young people.
follow_ups: The most common pets in my area are dogs and cats. The main reason is that they are useful and easy to look after. For example, dogs can protect the house, and cats can catch mice. They are also cheap and easy to find in pet shops.

Yes, I think parents should encourage their kids to keep a pet. The main reason is that a pet can teach children to be kind and responsible. For example, a child can feed the fish every morning before school. However, parents should help them at first.

I think many people choose not to keep pets because they are too busy. A pet needs food, exercise and attention every day. For example, people who work long hours cannot walk a dog twice a day. Others live in small apartments or worry about the cost.

2.answer:
In recent years, more and more children have started eating too much junk food, sweets and fizzy drinks. Parents and doctors are worried because this habit can harm children's bodies and minds. This essay will discuss the main problems of this issue and suggest some solutions.

There are two main problems of unhealthy eating among children. Firstly, it harms their physical health. Fast food and soft drinks contain a lot of fat and sugar, so many children become overweight. For example, many primary school pupils in big cities now have tooth decay, and some even have diabetes. Secondly, a poor diet can affect children's studies and mood. This is because sugary snacks give quick energy, but children soon feel tired and cannot focus. For instance, a child who drinks cola instead of eating breakfast may feel sleepy in class. As a result, his school results may go down.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, parents should cook healthy meals at home and limit junk food. For instance, they can prepare rice, fish and vegetables for dinner and keep fruit instead of sweets in the fridge. Children usually copy their parents' eating habits, so they will learn to enjoy healthy food. Secondly, schools should teach children about healthy food and stop selling sugary drinks. A good example is a school canteen that sells fresh fruit and milk instead of soft drinks. Thanks to this, children can get enough energy to concentrate in class.

In conclusion, unhealthy eating harms children's health and their school results. However, these problems can be reduced if parents cook healthy meals at home and schools offer healthier food and drinks.

Today I would like to talk about the importance of teamwork skills for students. In my opinion, teamwork is one of the most useful skills that students can learn.

Firstly, a good leader plays an important role in guiding a team. The leader divides the work fairly and makes sure everyone knows their tasks. For example, in my university group project, our leader made a clear plan, so we finished the report one week early.

Secondly, sharing and combining ideas leads to better results. Each member has different knowledge and experience, so the team can see a problem from many sides. For instance, when my classmates and I prepared a presentation, one person found the data and another designed beautiful slides.

Thirdly, teamwork brings many benefits to studying and future careers. Students who can work in a team learn faster and find jobs more easily. A good example is my research job, where I work with doctors and engineers every day.

Another important point is that teamwork helps students make friends and build good relationships. When they work hard together, they get to know each other better. For example, some of my best friends today were my teammates at university.

To sum up, teamwork skills are important because of good leadership, shared ideas, future benefits and friendship.
3.own_idea: Making friends and building good relationships
follow_ups: I think a good team leader should be confident and fair. The main reason is that team members need someone they can trust and follow. For example, a good leader listens to every member before making a decision. He or she also encourages the team when things are difficult.

No, I do not think working in a team is always better. The main reason is that some tasks are faster when we do them alone. For example, I write short reports by myself because discussing them takes too long. However, for big projects, teamwork is usually better.

Students can improve their teamwork skills by joining group projects and student clubs. The main reason is that they learn best through real practice. For example, in a volunteer club, they must share tasks and solve problems together. They should also practise listening and respecting different opinions.
