2.answer:
Since COVID-19, many people have worked from home instead of going to the office. People have different opinions on whether this change brings parents and children closer or pushes them apart. This essay will discuss both views, but I believe that it makes family bonds stronger.

On the one hand, some people believe that working from home harms the relationship between parents and children. This is because work and family life get mixed together in the same place. For example, a mother may answer work emails during dinner or ask her child to keep quiet because of an online meeting. As a result, children may feel that their parents are always busy, even when they are at home.

On the other hand, I agree with those who think that working from home makes family bonds stronger. Firstly, parents can spend more time with their children every day. They do not have to travel to work, so they save time and feel less tired. For instance, a father can take his son to school in the morning and have lunch with him at home. Secondly, parents can follow their children's daily lives more closely. This means that they notice problems early and can help in time. A good example is a mother who sees that her daughter looks sad after school and talks with her immediately. Therefore, children feel loved and supported.

In conclusion, although working from home can mix work and family life, I believe that it brings parents and children closer because they spend more time together. Parents can also notice their children's problems early. However, they should set clear working hours to protect family time.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about why face-to-face communication is more beneficial than other types of communication. In my opinion, meeting people in person is still the best way to communicate.

Firstly, face-to-face communication helps us convey emotions and body language clearly. We can see a person's smile, eyes and gestures, not only hear their words. For example, when I show a new AI tool to doctors, they can see that I am really excited about it.

Secondly, it reduces misunderstandings compared to text-based communication. A short text message can sound cold or rude, even when the writer does not mean it. For instance, my colleague once replied to my long message with just one word, and I thought she was angry, but she was only busy.

Thirdly, talking in person builds stronger and more trusting relationships. People feel closer when they share a meal or a cup of coffee together. A good example is my team, which has lunch together every Friday, so we trust each other more.

Another important point is that face-to-face meetings help us solve problems faster. We can ask questions and get answers immediately. For example, a ten-minute meeting can solve a problem that takes a whole day of emails.

To sum up, face-to-face communication is more beneficial because it shows emotions, reduces misunderstandings, builds trust and saves time.
follow_ups: Yes, I think technology has weakened these skills, especially among young people. The main reason is that many of them prefer chatting on their phones to talking in person. For example, some students feel very nervous when they have to speak at a job interview. They are not used to making eye contact.

I think online communication is more suitable when people live far away from each other. The main reason is that it is fast and cheap. For example, I have online meetings with research partners in other countries every month. It is also useful for sending quick messages to colleagues.

People can improve these skills by practising them in real life. The main reason is that communication is a skill, so we get better with practice. For example, we can put our phones away, make eye contact and listen carefully to others. Joining clubs or giving presentations is also good practice.

2.answer:
In recent years, more and more workers have moved from one company to another every year or two. They no longer want to build a long career in one place. This essay will discuss the main causes of this trend and its effects.

There are two main causes of frequent job changes. Firstly, many employees want a higher salary quickly. New companies often offer more money to attract experienced staff, so moving is the fastest way to earn more. For example, a young programmer in Ho Chi Minh City can get a much better offer simply by joining another company. Secondly, many young people want to learn new skills and try different kinds of work. This is because they feel bored if they do the same tasks for many years. For instance, a marketing assistant may move to a bigger company to work on international projects.

This trend has two serious effects. The first effect is that workers may not build deep skills or strong relationships. They often leave before they fully understand their job or their colleagues. A good example is a person who has had five jobs in five years. Employers may think that this person is unreliable and will leave again soon. Another effect is that companies lose money and experience. They have to spend time and money to hire and train new staff again and again. For example, when an experienced nurse leaves a hospital, the new nurse needs several months to learn the work. As a result, the quality of service may go down.

In conclusion, frequent job changes are mainly caused by the wish for higher pay and new skills. They lead to weaker careers for workers and higher costs for companies. Therefore, both workers and employers should think carefully about this trend.

Today I would like to talk about the benefits of learning a new language. In my opinion, learning a new language is one of the best investments we can make.

Firstly, learning a language brings cognitive benefits, such as improved memory and problem-solving skills. When we learn new words and grammar rules, our brain has to work hard every day. For example, I learn ten English words every morning, and I feel that my memory has become better.

Secondly, a new language opens up career and educational opportunities. Many good companies and universities want people who can speak English or another foreign language. For instance, in my research job, I need English to read medical articles and work with foreign partners.

Thirdly, learning a language gives us cultural understanding and stronger connections with others. When we speak someone's language, we understand their way of thinking better. A good example is my friend who learnt Korean, and now she has many close friends in Seoul.

Another important point is that we can enjoy films, books and music in the original language. Translations often lose the humour and the beauty of the original. For example, I enjoy Harry Potter much more in English than in Vietnamese.

To sum up, learning a new language is good for our brain, our career, our relationships and our free time. I think it is never too late to start.
3.own_idea: Enjoying films, books and music in the original language
follow_ups: I think the best way is to practise a little every day. The main reason is that regular practice helps us remember words for a long time. For example, learners can listen to a podcast on the bus and speak with a friend for ten minutes. They should not be afraid of making mistakes.

Yes, I think everyone should learn at least one foreign language. The main reason is that the world is more connected today, so we often need to talk to people from other countries. For example, a nurse may need English to help a foreign patient. A foreign language also gives us more job opportunities.

Technology helps people learn languages in many ways. Firstly, learners can practise anytime and anywhere on their phones. For example, apps like Duolingo let people study for ten minutes a day for free. Learners can also join online classes with teachers from other countries.

2.answer:
Nowadays, adverts are everywhere, from TV screens and social media to buses and city streets. Advertising is useful for businesses and customers, but it can also cause problems. This essay will discuss both its advantages and disadvantages.

On the one hand, advertising has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that it often persuades people to buy things they do not need. Adverts usually show products as perfect, and they make people believe they will be happier if they buy them. Some adverts also use famous singers or footballers to attract young people. For example, many children ask their parents for sweet snacks or new toys after watching adverts on YouTube. As a result, families may waste money, and children may develop unhealthy eating habits.

On the other hand, advertising brings two important benefits. Firstly, it gives customers useful information about products and services. People can learn about prices, new products and special offers quickly, so they can make better choices. For instance, an advert for a new health app can show people how to book a doctor's appointment online. As a result, people can save a lot of time. Secondly, advertising supports economic growth. When companies advertise, they sell more products, so they can hire more workers. This is especially important for small and new businesses. A good example is a small coffee shop that becomes famous after a few adverts on Facebook. Thanks to this, it can open more branches and create new jobs for local people.

In conclusion, advertising has both advantages and disadvantages. It may encourage people to buy things they do not need, but it also gives useful information and helps the economy grow.

Today I would like to talk about the importance of leadership. In my opinion, a good leader can make a big difference to any team.

Firstly, a leader guides and motivates team members towards common goals. Without a leader, people may work in different directions. For example, my research team has a clear plan every month because our team leader explains our goals in meetings.

Secondly, a leader makes effective decisions in difficult situations. When there is a problem, the team needs someone to decide quickly and calmly. For instance, during the COVID-19 pandemic, many hospital directors had to change their plans almost every day.

Thirdly, a good leader builds trust and keeps the team united. When members trust their leader, they share ideas and help each other more. A good example is my former manager, who always listened to everyone and kept her promises.

Another important point is that a leader helps team members develop their skills. Good leaders give useful feedback and new challenges. For example, my professor often lets young researchers present at conferences to gain experience.

To sum up, leadership is important because good leaders guide and motivate the team, make wise decisions and build trust. They also help members develop their skills.
3.own_idea: Helping team members develop their skills
follow_ups: I think leadership skills can be learned. The main reason is that skills such as communication and decision-making improve with practice. For example, many people become good leaders after taking training courses and getting experience at work. However, some people are naturally more confident than others.

In my opinion, a good leader should be honest, fair and a good listener. This is because team members only follow a leader they trust. For example, a leader who listens to everyone's ideas makes people feel respected. A good leader should also stay calm under pressure.

Yes, I admire my former professor at medical school. She was strict, but she was always fair and kind to her students. For example, she spent extra time helping weak students before exams. Thanks to her, I learnt that a good leader cares about people, not only results.

2.answer:
Nowadays, more and more people spend their holidays exploring new places, both in their own country and overseas. This hobby has clear benefits, but it also has some disadvantages. This essay will discuss both its advantages and disadvantages.

On the one hand, travelling has one main drawback. The biggest problem is that it can be very expensive. Travellers have to pay for flights, hotels, food and tickets, and these costs add up quickly. For example, a one-week trip to Japan can cost a young office worker several months of savings. As a result, some people spend too much money and have less left for important things such as health care or their children's education.

On the other hand, travelling brings two important benefits. Firstly, it helps people learn about new cultures. When we visit a new place, we can see how local people live, eat and celebrate their festivals. For instance, a visit to Hue helps young Vietnamese people understand the history of the Nguyen Dynasty much better than a textbook. As a result, they become more open-minded and respect people who are different from them. Secondly, travelling helps people relax and reduce stress. This means that they can forget about work for a while and enjoy new experiences. A good example is a family who spends a weekend at the beach in Nha Trang after a busy month. Thanks to this, they come back home healthier and happier, and they can work better.

In conclusion, tourism and travel have both advantages and disadvantages. Travelling can be costly, but it also helps people learn about other cultures and relax. Therefore, people should plan their trips carefully to enjoy the benefits.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the responsibilities of keeping pets. In my opinion, keeping a pet is fun, but it also means a lot of work.

Firstly, owners must provide proper food, shelter and healthcare. Pets need healthy meals, a safe place to sleep and regular visits to the vet. For example, I take my cat to the vet for her vaccinations every year.

Secondly, owners need to ensure regular exercise and attention. Pets can become sad or unhealthy if they stay alone all day. For instance, dogs need a walk every day, and cats need someone to play with.

Thirdly, owners must be financially and emotionally committed in the long term. A dog or a cat can live for more than ten years, and food and vet bills can be expensive. A good example is my neighbour, who still looks after his old dog even though it is sick now.

Another important point is that owners should train their pets to behave well. A well-trained pet does not disturb neighbours or hurt other people. For example, a dog should learn not to bark at night or bite strangers.

To sum up, pet owners must provide food, shelter and healthcare, give regular exercise and attention, and make a long-term commitment. Owners should also train their pets well.
follow_ups: Dogs and cats are the most popular pets in Vietnam. This is because they are friendly and easy to find. For example, many families keep a dog to protect their house and a cat to catch mice. Some people also keep fish or birds because they need less space.

Keeping a pet has many benefits. The main one is that pets reduce stress and make us feel less lonely. For example, when I come home after a long day, my cat always runs to the door to greet me. Walking a dog also helps owners stay active.

Pets can bring some problems to their owners. The main problem is that they need a lot of time and money. For example, owners must pay for food and vet bills, and they cannot travel easily. Pets can also make noise or damage furniture.

2.answer:
Nowadays, many famous places welcome more and more visitors every year. This growth helps local people earn money, but it also causes problems for nature and for residents. This essay will discuss both its advantages and disadvantages.

On the one hand, the rise in tourist numbers brings one main benefit. The biggest benefit is that it helps the local economy grow. Tourists spend money on hotels, food, transport and souvenirs, so many new jobs are created. For example, in Hoi An, many families earn a good living by running small homestays, restaurants or tailor shops. As a result, local people have higher incomes, and the government can spend more money on roads and schools.

On the other hand, too many tourists cause two serious problems. Firstly, they can damage the environment. This is because more visitors mean more rubbish, more water use and more pollution. For instance, some beaches in Vietnam become dirty after busy holidays because people leave plastic bottles and food bags on the sand. Local authorities then have to spend a lot of money on cleaning them. Secondly, mass tourism can lower the quality of life for local people. Streets become crowded and noisy, and the prices of food and housing often go up. A good example is Da Lat, where traffic jams are now common at weekends and during holidays. As a result, some local people feel that their city no longer belongs to them.

In conclusion, the increase in tourist numbers has both advantages and disadvantages. It brings money and jobs to local communities, but it can also harm the environment and make life harder for residents. That is why tourism needs to be managed carefully.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the negative effects of social media on young people. In my opinion, social media can harm young people in several ways.

Firstly, it increases the risk of anxiety and depression. Young people often worry about how many likes and comments they get. For example, a teenager may feel sad for days if a photo receives only a few likes.

Secondly, social media reduces face-to-face social interaction. Many young people chat online for hours but rarely meet their friends in person. For instance, I often see groups of students in coffee shops where everyone is looking at their phones.

Thirdly, young people are exposed to misinformation and unrealistic comparisons. They may believe fake news, or compare themselves with perfect pictures of other people. A good example is fake health advice on TikTok, which some students follow without checking.

Another important point is that social media leads to poor sleep and less time for study. Many teenagers scroll through their phones late at night instead of sleeping or doing homework. For example, my cousin used to watch videos until one o'clock in the morning, so she often fell asleep in class.

To sum up, social media can cause anxiety, less face-to-face contact, misinformation, poor sleep and less study time. Young people should use it wisely.
3.own_idea: Poor sleep and less time for study
follow_ups: Yes, I think young people are more vulnerable than adults. The main reason is that they care a lot about what their friends think of them. For example, a teenager may feel worthless if classmates leave bad comments on a photo. They also have less experience in checking information.

Parents can do several things to help. First, they should set clear rules about screen time. For example, phones can be banned during meals and after ten o'clock at night. Parents should also talk with their children about fake news and online safety.

Yes, I think they should take more responsibility. This is because these companies earn a lot of money from young users. For example, they could limit the time children spend on the app and remove harmful content faster. They should also check users' ages more carefully.

2.answer:
People have different opinions on whether we should post details of our daily lives online. Some see it as a way to stay close to others, while others see many risks. This essay will discuss both views, but I believe that sharing too much online does more harm than good.

On the one hand, some people believe that sharing personal experiences online helps them connect with others and keep memories. This is because social media lets friends and relatives follow each other's lives easily. For example, a mother can post photos of her baby, so grandparents who live far away can watch the child grow up. As a result, families feel closer, and they also have an online album of special moments.

On the other hand, I agree with those who think that sharing too much is harmful. Firstly, it can put our privacy and safety at risk. Strangers can learn where we live, work and travel from our posts. For instance, a person who posts holiday photos while away may tell thieves that the house is empty. As a result, the family may lose valuable things while they are on holiday. Secondly, social media creates pressure to show a perfect life. People often post only their best moments, so others feel that their own lives are not good enough. A good example is teenagers who edit their photos many times before posting them. Therefore, many of them feel anxious and unhappy with their appearance.

In conclusion, although sharing our lives online helps us connect and save memories, I believe that it does more harm than good because it threatens privacy and creates pressure. We should think carefully before we post.

In this situation, among the three options, I think talking directly to my friend is the best choice. I choose it for two main reasons.

The first reason is that it gives my friend a chance to correct his mistake himself. By that, I mean he can go to the teacher and tell the truth before anyone reports him. For example, he may say sorry and ask to take the exam again, so his punishment may be lighter.

Another reason is that it keeps our friendship and still shows that cheating is wrong. In other words, I am honest with him, and I do not go behind his back. For instance, I can meet him after the exam and explain calmly that cheating is unfair to other students.

There are also some reasons why I do not choose the other two options. Regarding ignoring what I saw and saying nothing, I do not think it is the best choice because it is unfair to the students who studied hard. As for reporting the incident to the teacher, I do not think it is the best option either because it may end our friendship before he can explain.

To sum up, out of these three options, I believe talking directly to my friend is the best choice because it is honest, fair and kind.

Today I would like to talk about the benefits of cashless payment. In my opinion, paying without cash makes our daily lives much easier.

Firstly, cashless payment brings convenience in daily transactions. We only need a phone to pay for almost everything. For example, I pay for my coffee, my groceries and my Grab rides with a banking app.

Secondly, it offers better safety and security for our money. We do not need to carry a lot of cash, so we worry less about losing it. For instance, if someone steals my phone, they still cannot open my banking app without my password.

Thirdly, cashless payment improves the speed and efficiency of payment processes. Scanning a QR code takes only a few seconds, and there is no need to count change. A good example is the supermarket near my house, where the queues are much shorter now.

Another important point is that it is easy to track spending. Every payment is saved in the app, so we can see where our money goes. For example, I check my banking app at the end of each month to plan my budget.

To sum up, cashless payment is convenient, safe and fast. It also makes it easy to track our spending.
follow_ups: No, I do not think cash will disappear completely. The main reason is that many older people and people in the countryside still prefer cash. For example, my grandmother only uses cash when she goes to the local market. However, cash will probably become much less common.

The biggest risk is online fraud. Criminals can send fake messages or links to steal people's bank information. For example, one of my colleagues lost money after she clicked a fake link that looked like a bank message. Another risk is that we may spend too much because paying is so easy.

Cashless payment has made shopping in Vietnam faster and more convenient. People now pay by QR code, even at small street stalls. For example, the woman who sells bread near my office has a QR code on her cart. As a result, many people carry very little cash now.

Hi Jane,

Thank you for your email. It is great news that your family is coming to Hanoi.

Regarding where to stay, I think a homestay is a better choice than a hotel. It is usually cheaper, and it has more space for a big family. You can also live with a local family and try home-cooked Vietnamese food. I stayed at a lovely homestay in the Old Quarter last year.

As for the weather, Hanoi is quite pleasant in September. It is the start of autumn, so it is a little cooler than in summer. However, it still rains quite often, so remember to bring an umbrella.

About tourist attractions, I would recommend a few famous places. On your first morning, you can walk around Hoan Kiem Lake and visit Ngoc Son Temple. In the afternoon, you should visit the Temple of Literature. In the evening, you can watch a water puppet show near the lake.

I hope you have a wonderful trip. Let me know if you need any more help.

Best wishes,
Minh

2.answer:
People have different opinions on what makes workers happy with their jobs. Some say money matters most, while others value a good workplace and chances to develop. This essay will discuss both views, but I believe that the working environment and growth opportunities are more important.

On the one hand, some people believe that salary is the most important factor. This is because people need money to pay for housing, food and their children's education, especially in big cities. For example, a young worker with a family may accept a stressful job simply because it pays well. As a result, a good salary can make employees feel secure and satisfied, at least for a while.

On the other hand, I agree with those who think that other factors matter more than money. Firstly, a friendly working environment makes people happy every day. Workers spend about eight hours a day at work, so good relationships with colleagues and managers are very important. For instance, my friend left a well-paid job at a bank because her manager often shouted at the staff. She now earns less, but she feels much happier at her new company. Secondly, opportunities for growth give people a sense of purpose. When employees can learn new skills and get promoted, they feel that their work has value. A good example is my own job, where I can attend training courses and join new AI projects. Therefore, I feel motivated even when the work is difficult.

In conclusion, although salary makes workers feel secure, I believe that a good workplace and growth matter more because they bring daily happiness and a sense of purpose.

Today I would like to talk about the impact of technology on study habits. In my opinion, technology has changed the way we study in many positive ways.

Firstly, online learning tools help students develop digital skills. When students use these tools, they learn how to search, type and share files. For example, my younger sister makes slides on Canva and hands in her homework on Google Classroom.

Secondly, students can use software and applications to organize and manage their study. These apps help them plan their time and remember deadlines. For instance, I use Google Calendar to plan my reading and my English lessons every week.

Thirdly, technology enables flexible study schedules and remote learning. Students can join classes from home or watch recorded lessons later. A good example is my online English course, which I can take at night after work.

Another important point is that technology gives us easy access to information. In the past, students had to go to the library to find books. Now, they can find articles and videos about almost any topic in a few seconds.

To sum up, technology has improved study habits through digital skills, study apps, flexible learning and easy access to information. However, students should still use it wisely.
follow_ups: I think technology has made studying easier. The main reason is that students can find information and lessons quickly online. For example, when I do not understand a medical term, I can look it up in a few seconds. However, phones can also distract students if they are not careful.

I use a few apps for studying. I use Duolingo and YouTube to improve my English because they are free and fun. For example, I watch a short English video every morning before work. I also use Google Calendar to plan my study time.

Yes, I think schools should use more technology, but not too much. This is because technology makes lessons more interesting and helps students learn digital skills. For example, a teacher can show a short video about the human heart in a biology lesson. However, students still need books and face-to-face discussions.

2.answer:
People have different opinions on whether students should attend extra lessons after school. Some think these lessons are useful, while others see them as a heavy burden. This essay will discuss both views, but I believe that too many extra classes do more harm than good.

On the one hand, some people believe that extra classes help students improve their knowledge and skills. This is because teachers in these classes can explain difficult lessons again and give students more practice. For example, a student who is weak at maths can understand the lessons much better after a few months of extra classes. As a result, he may feel more confident and get higher marks in his exams.

On the other hand, I agree with those who think that extra classes put unnecessary pressure on young learners. Firstly, too many classes make students tired and stressed. Many children study at school all day and then go to extra classes until nine o'clock at night. For instance, my neighbour's son has classes every evening, and he often looks exhausted. Lack of sleep can also harm his health and his memory. Secondly, extra classes take away valuable free time. Children need time to play sports, enjoy their hobbies and talk with their families. A good example is a child who plays football at weekends. This helps him stay healthy and make friends. Therefore, free time is just as important as extra lessons for children's development.

In conclusion, although extra classes can help weak students, I believe that too many of them do more harm than good because they cause stress and take away free time. Students should choose only the classes that they really need.

Today I would like to talk about the reasons why young people nowadays prefer eating out. In my opinion, eating out is popular because it is convenient and fun.

Firstly, many young people have busy lifestyles and lack time to cook. They work or study all day, and they feel too tired to cook in the evening. For example, many of my colleagues buy dinner on their way home from work.

Secondly, eating out is a way to socialize with friends. Young people like to meet and chat over a meal or a drink. For instance, my friends and I often have hotpot together on Friday evenings.

Thirdly, there is a wide variety of food choices available. In big cities, people can find Vietnamese, Korean, Japanese and Western food on the same street. A good example is District 1 in Ho Chi Minh City, where I can try a new dish every week.

Another important point is that eating out is cheap in Vietnam. A bowl of pho or a plate of broken rice costs only about fifty thousand dong. Therefore, many students can afford to eat out every day.

To sum up, young people prefer eating out because of their busy lifestyles, their social lives and the wide variety of food. The affordable prices also make it easy for them.

2.answer:
In recent years, many people, especially teenagers, have chosen to spend their free time on phones and social media instead of books. Many teachers are worried that this change will harm society in the long run. This essay will discuss the main problems of this issue and suggest some solutions.

There are two main problems caused by this trend. Firstly, young people who read less often have weaker language and thinking skills. This is because books teach new words and help readers follow long ideas. For example, many teachers say that their students now find it hard to write a long essay. As a result, the country may have fewer good writers and thinkers in the future. Secondly, people who rarely read find it difficult to focus for a long time. This is because short videos make them want something new every few seconds. For instance, a teenager may stop reading a novel after only two or three pages.

However, there are some ways to solve this problem. Firstly, schools should make reading a regular part of school life. Teachers can give students fifteen minutes every day to read a book of their choice. A good example is a school reading club, where students talk about their favourite books every month. Secondly, parents should limit their children's screen time and read with them at home. When parents read, children usually copy them. For example, a family can turn off their phones for thirty minutes every evening and read together. Thanks to this, children can slowly learn to focus and enjoy books again.

In conclusion, the decline in reading weakens young people's language skills and their ability to focus. However, this problem can be reduced if schools encourage daily reading and parents limit screen time at home.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of keeping pets. In my opinion, pets bring many good things to our lives.

Firstly, pets can improve our physical health through daily activities. Dog owners need to walk their dogs every morning and evening. For example, my neighbour walks his dog in the park for thirty minutes every day, so he is very fit.

Secondly, pets provide emotional support and reduce stress. They are always happy to see us, and they love us without judging us. For instance, when I come home tired after work, playing with my cat makes me feel calm.

Thirdly, pets help strengthen bonds within the family. Family members often take care of a pet together and talk about it. A good example is my cousin's family, who take their dog to the beach every weekend.

Another important point is that pets teach children responsibility. Children learn that a pet needs food, water and love every day. For example, my niece feeds her goldfish every morning before school.

To sum up, keeping pets is good for our physical health, our emotions and our family bonds. Pets also teach children responsibility, so I think many families should consider having one.
follow_ups: In my area, dogs and cats are the most common pets. Dogs are popular because they can protect the house, while cats are easy to look after in small flats. For example, my neighbours keep a small dog and two cats. Some families also keep fish or birds.

Yes, I think it is suitable, but parents should help them. The main reason is that pets teach children to be kind and responsible. For example, a child can feed a cat or clean a fish tank every day. However, young children should not look after a big dog alone.

Many people dislike keeping pets because pets need a lot of time and money. They must be fed, cleaned and taken to the vet regularly. For example, my friends who work long hours cannot leave a dog alone all day. Some people are also allergic to cat or dog hair.

Hi Linh,

Thank you for your email. I moved into my new house last month, and I am so happy that you want to visit.

Regarding the location, my new house is in District 7, Ho Chi Minh City. It is on a small street near Nguyen Thi Thap Street. I like this area because it is quiet and green, and Lotte Mart is only five minutes away.

As for getting there, the easiest way is to book a Grab car from the city centre. The trip takes about thirty minutes. When you see a big pharmacy on Nguyen Thi Thap Street, turn left. My house is the third one on the right, with a blue gate.

About your question on decoration, I am planning to use a simple and modern style. I like bright and tidy rooms, so I will paint the walls white. I will also put green plants in the living room and make a small reading corner.

2.answer:
Nowadays, more and more people buy things on websites and apps instead of going to shops. This change has happened very quickly in many countries, including Vietnam. This essay will discuss the main reasons for this trend.

To begin with, online shopping helps individual customers in two ways. Firstly, it saves a lot of time and effort. People can order products at any time without leaving their homes. For example, an office worker can buy groceries on her phone during her lunch break. Secondly, prices online are often lower than in shops. This is because online sellers do not need to pay high rent for a shop. For instance, a pair of shoes on Shopee is often cheaper than the same pair in a shopping mall. As a result, many students and young families prefer to shop online.

In addition, technology and businesses have also made online shopping more popular. One important point is that there is a much wider choice of products online. Customers can compare many items and read reviews from other buyers before they decide. A good example is my mother, who compared five rice cookers on an app before she bought one. Another point is that payment and delivery are now fast and safe. People can pay with banking apps, and many orders arrive within one or two days. For example, I often order books in the morning and receive them the next day. Thanks to this, customers trust online shopping more than before.

In conclusion, online shopping has become popular for several reasons. It saves time and money for individuals, and it offers more choices, easy payment and fast delivery. That is why so many people now prefer to shop online.

In this situation, among the three options, I think using a phone while driving is the best choice for the campaign. I choose it for two main reasons.

The first reason is that this behaviour can kill people in just a few seconds. By that, I mean a driver who looks at a phone cannot watch the road carefully. For example, if a motorbike rider reads a message at a busy crossroads, he may hit a child who is crossing the street.

Another reason is that many people do it every day without thinking it is dangerous. In other words, they believe a short call or a quick message is not a big problem. For instance, in Ho Chi Minh City, I often see delivery drivers checking their phones while they are riding. A campaign can help them understand the real danger.

There are also some reasons why I do not choose the other two options. Regarding smoking in public places, I do not think it is the best choice because its harm is slower and many places already ban it. As for making noise in public areas, I do not think it is the best option either because noise is annoying, but it rarely kills anyone.

To sum up, out of these three options, I believe using a phone while driving is the best choice because it is urgent, common and life-threatening.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about how communication has changed compared to the past. In my opinion, communication today is much faster and easier, but it also has some problems.

Firstly, modern tools bring great speed and convenience. In the past, people often waited for days to receive a letter. Now, for example, I can send a long report to my colleagues in a few seconds.

Secondly, digital communication is replacing face-to-face communication. Many people now chat online more than they talk in person. For instance, my friends and I sometimes sit in a coffee shop but look at our phones most of the time.

Thirdly, smartphones and social media play a big role in our lives. With a smartphone, we can call, send photos and share news anywhere. A good example is my family, who share photos in a Zalo group every day.

Another important point is that talking to people abroad is much cheaper now. In the past, international phone calls were very expensive. Today, I can make a video call to my cousin in Australia for free.

To sum up, communication today is faster and more digital, and smartphones and social media play a central role in it. It is also much cheaper than before. However, we should still spend time talking face to face.
follow_ups: I think modern tools have made us closer to people far away, but more distant from people nearby. The main reason is that we can contact anyone at any time. For example, I talk to my cousin in Australia every week. However, at family dinners, many people look at their phones instead of talking.

I use Zalo and email most often. Zalo is fast and free, so I use it to chat with my family and friends. For example, my family has a group chat where we share photos and news every day. I use email for my work with doctors and colleagues.

I think communication will become even faster and more realistic in the future. The main reason is that AI and virtual reality are developing very quickly. For example, people may meet in a virtual room and feel like they are sitting together. AI may also translate different languages immediately.
